"**Property**" means the Land, the Improvements, all fixtures and appurtenances, all Development Documents, all personal property and general intangibles used in connection with the Project, all permits and approvals, all leases and rents, and all proceeds of the foregoing.

"**Recourse Triggers**" has the meaning set forth in **Section 13.4**.

"**Refinancing Payoff**" means the amount required to satisfy in full, and to cause to be released of record, the deed of trust dated September 14, 2018 recorded in Book 6215, Page 892, Durham County Registry, from Foster Street Properties LLC to the trustee named therein for the benefit of Triangle Commercial Bank, securing an original indebtedness of $3,400,000 (the "**Prior Deed of Trust**"), together with all accrued interest, fees, prepayment premiums, per diem interest through the Closing Date and the costs of recordation of the cancellation or certificate of satisfaction.

"**Relevant Governmental Body**" means the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (or the Federal Reserve Bank of New York) and/or a committee officially endorsed or convened by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (or the Federal Reserve Bank of New York), or any successor thereto.

"**Rent Roll**" means a current rent roll of the Property certified by Borrower.

"**Required Equity Contribution**" means, as of the Closing Date, the amount set forth as such on the Closing Statement and approved by Lender, being the amount by which Total Project Costs (as reflected in the Approved Budget, as conformed pursuant to **Section 11.2** to include the Refinancing Payoff) exceed the sum of the Commitment plus the Mezzanine Loan, and in no event less than $2,140,000, all of which must be funded from sources of the type described in **Section 2.4(b)**.

"**Retainage**" means ten percent (10%) of the cost of each hard cost line item of the Approved Budget funded by the Loan, withheld from each Progress Advance and held and released in accordance with **Section 9.3**.

"**Senior Debt Service**" means, for any period, the sum of all payments of interest and principal that would be due on the Loan during such period on the basis of interest-only payments at the Mini-Perm Rate in effect on the date of determination, applied to the outstanding principal balance of the Loan; and, for purposes of any test performed on a pro forma basis, applied to the full Commitment.

"**SOFR**" means the Secured Overnight Financing Rate as published by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York (or a successor administrator) for the applicable U.S. Government Securities Business Day.

"**SOFR Floor**" means one percent (1.00%) per annum.

"**Soil Management Plan**" means the soil management plan for the Affected Area required by Condition 3 of the NFA Letter, approved by NCDEQ prior to any subsurface disturbance in the Affected Area.

"**Stabilization**" means the first date on which the Project has achieved not less than ninety-five percent (95%) physical occupancy of the residential units for two (2) consecutive calendar months.

"**Stabilized NOI**" means, as of any date of determination, (a) for purposes of any covenant test occurring before the first anniversary of the date of Substantial Completion, the stabilized net operating income of the Property set forth in the most recent Appraisal ($4,876,800 per annum as of the Effective Date), and (b) thereafter, the actual net operating income of the Property for the trailing twelve (12) month period then ended (or, if the Project has not been operating for twelve (12) months, the annualized net operating income for the period since Substantial Completion), in each case calculated in accordance with GAAP consistent with the operating statement delivered under **Section 23.2**, excluding any non-recurring items and any income from the Affected Area that is not permitted under the NFA Letter.

"**Substantial Completion**" means substantial completion of the Project within the meaning of the GMP Contract, evidenced by (a) a certificate of substantial completion from the Architect, (b) the issuance of a temporary or final certificate of occupancy for all residential units, retail bays and the parking garage by the City of Durham, and (c) Lender's receipt of a third-party inspector's certification to that effect.

"**Total Debt Service**" means, for any period, the sum of Senior Debt Service and Mezzanine Debt Service for such period.

"**Total Project Costs**" means the aggregate of all costs and expenses incurred or to be incurred in connection with the acquisition, development, construction and completion of the Project, as set forth in the Approved Budget, including all hard costs, soft costs, financing costs, the Interest Reserve, the Developer Fee, contingency, and the Refinancing Payoff.

"**UCC**" means the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect in the State of North Carolina.

"**Vapor Mitigation System**" means the passive sub-slab depressurization system, with the capability of conversion to an active depressurization system, required by Condition 1 of the NFA Letter to be installed beneath any enclosed structure constructed over the Affected Area.

## Section 1.2 Interpretation

In this Agreement: (a) headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation; (b) the words "include," "includes" and "including" are deemed to be followed by "without limitation"; (c) references to Articles, Sections, Schedules and Exhibits are to Articles and Sections of, and Schedules and Exhibits to, this Agreement, each of which is incorporated herein by reference; (d) "hereof," "herein" and "hereunder" refer to this Agreement as a whole; (e) references to any statute, rule or regulation include any amendment, successor or re-codification thereof and the rules and regulations promulgated thereunder; (f) references to any document include such document as amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time in accordance with its terms and, where applicable, this Agreement; (g) the singular includes the plural and vice versa, and any gender includes all genders; (h) references to "$" or "dollars" are to the lawful currency of the United States; and (i) no presumption shall operate against the party that drafted this Agreement or any Loan Document.

## Section 1.3 Accounting Terms; Determinations

All accounting terms not specifically defined herein shall be construed in accordance with GAAP applied on a consistent basis. All determinations of the Applicable Rate, Daily Simple SOFR, the Benchmark Replacement, the Loan-to-Cost Ratio, the Loan-to-Value Ratio, DSCR, Combined DSCR and all other financial calculations shall be made by Lender in its reasonable discretion, in good faith, and shall be conclusive and binding on Borrower absent manifest error.

## Section 1.4 Day Count; Rounding

All interest under this Agreement and the Note shall be computed on the basis of actual days elapsed over a 360-day year. Any change in the Applicable Rate resulting from a change in Daily Simple SOFR shall become effective automatically on the day of such change, without notice to Borrower. Any determination of a rate of interest that would otherwise result in a fraction of one one-hundredth of one percent (0.01%) shall be rounded upward to the nearest one one-hundredth of one percent.

# ARTICLE 2 — THE LOAN

## Section 2.1 Commitment and Obligation to Advance

Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and the other Loan Documents, Lender agrees to make Advances to Borrower from time to time during the Construction Period (and, in the case of the Retainage release and the final portion of the Developer Fee, during the Mini-Perm Period) in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed at any time outstanding the Borrowing Base Availability, and in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed the Commitment. The Loan is a fully committed construction-to-mini-permanent facility. The Loan is **not** a revolving credit facility, and no amount repaid or prepaid may be reborrowed.

## Section 2.2 Purpose

The proceeds of the Loan shall be used solely (a) to pay or reimburse the hard costs, soft costs and financing costs of the Project set forth in the Approved Budget to the extent allocated to the Loan in the Approved Budget, (b) to fund the Interest Reserve, (c) to pay the Origination Fee to the extent permitted by **Section 5.1**, and (d) to pay such other costs of the Project as Lender may approve in writing. No proceeds of the Loan shall be used (i) to pay any distribution to any member of Borrower other than the Developer Fee to the extent permitted by **Section 11.6**, (ii) to pay any interest, principal, fee or other amount on the Mezzanine Loan, (iii) to pay any cost of the Project that is not set forth in the Approved Budget, (iv) to pay any cost of remediation of Hazardous Materials other than as expressly set forth in the Approved Budget, or (v) for any purpose that would violate any Anti-Corruption Law or any applicable sanctions regime, including those administered by OFAC.

## Section 2.3 Advances; Draw Schedule

The Loan shall be advanced in stages in accordance with the milestones, percentages of completion and amounts set forth in the Draw Schedule attached as **Exhibit C** (which supersedes the draw schedule set forth in Section 9.2 of the Term Sheet). The Draw Schedule is a schedule of anticipated disbursements and does not constitute a commitment by Lender to advance any amount other than in accordance with, and subject to, the conditions of **Article 9**. The aggregate amount of Advances shall not exceed the Commitment, and the final Advance (other than the release of Retainage) shall not exceed the amount necessary to pay the unpaid costs of the Project then due, less the Required Equity Contribution and all amounts funded by the Mezzanine Loan and by Equity Contributions.

## Section 2.4 Loan-to-Cost and Loan-to-Value Limitations; Equity Requirement

(a) **Borrowing Base Limitation.** Notwithstanding the Commitment, no Advance shall be made, and Borrower shall not be entitled to any Advance, to the extent that, after giving effect thereto, (i) the outstanding principal balance of the Loan would exceed the Borrowing Base Availability, (ii) the Loan-to-Cost Ratio would exceed eighty percent (80%), or (iii) the Loan-to-Value Ratio would exceed sixty-five percent (65%). Lender's determinations under this Section shall be made in good faith and shall be conclusive absent manifest error.

(b) **Required Equity.** On or before the Closing Date, Borrower shall have funded, and shall deliver evidence satisfactory to Lender (including bank statements, wire confirmations, and a source-of-funds certification in form satisfactory to Lender) of, Equity Contributions in an aggregate amount not less than the Required Equity Contribution. The Required Equity Contribution shall be funded from sources **other than** (i) the Mezzanine Loan or any proceeds thereof, (ii) Brightleaf Mezzanine Capital LLC, Brightleaf Investors Group LLC, Thomas R. Chen, or any Affiliate of any of the foregoing, (iii) any other financing or refinancing of the Property, or (iv) any borrowing that is secured, directly or indirectly, by the Property or by any interest in Borrower. Lender shall not be obligated to make any Advance (other than the Closing Advance) unless and until the Required Equity Contribution has been deposited and fully applied to Project Costs as contemplated by this Section.

(c) **Equity Escrow Account.** The Required Equity Contribution shall be deposited into a segregated, Lender-controlled account (the "**Equity Escrow Account**") at Closing, shall be applied to Project Costs before any Advance (other than the Closing Advance) is made, and shall be subject to a Pledged Account Agreement. Upon application of the Required Equity Contribution to Project Costs, the Borrowing Base Availability shall be computed giving effect to Total Project Costs as reduced by the portion of the Required Equity Contribution so applied, and the Commitment shall be correspondingly and permanently reduced so that the Loan-to-Cost Ratio does not exceed eighty percent (80%) at any time. Borrower and Lender shall record the resulting amount of the Commitment on the Closing Statement.

(d) **Conforming Amendment.** If, at or before Closing, the Approved Budget is conformed to include the Refinancing Payoff as a Project Cost in accordance with **Section 11.2**, then the Required Equity Contribution and the Commitment shall be recomputed on the conformed Approved Budget, and the Loan-to-Cost Ratio shall be tested against the conformed Total Project Costs; *provided* that in no event shall the Required Equity Contribution be less than $2,140,000.

(e) **No Waiver.** Any failure of the Loan to satisfy the limitations of this Section shall not constitute a waiver by Lender, and Lender may condition any Advance on the deposit of additional Equity Contributions in amounts sufficient to satisfy such limitations.

## Section 2.5 The Note

The Loan shall be evidenced by the Note, dated as of the Closing Date, payable to the order of Lender in the principal amount of the Commitment, bearing interest as provided in **Article 3** and repayable as provided in **Article 4**. The Note shall be entitled to the benefits of this Agreement and the other Loan Documents.

## Section 2.6 Loan Documents

The Obligations shall be secured by, and Borrower shall execute and deliver at Closing (or, with respect to any later-arising document, when required hereunder), the following Loan Documents, each in form and substance satisfactory to Lender and its counsel: (a) this Agreement; (b) the Note; (c) the Deed of Trust, Assignment of Rents, Security Agreement and Fixture Filing; (d) the Assignment of Rents and Leases; (e) the Security Agreement and UCC-1 financing statements; (f) the Assignments of Development Documents (including the GMP Contract and the Architect's Agreement); (g) the Collateral Assignment of Insurance Proceeds and Condemnation Awards; (h) the Pledge Agreements and Pledged Account Agreements; (i) the Guaranties; (j) the Environmental Indemnity; (k) the Intercreditor Agreement; (l) the Non-Consolidation Opinion; and (m) such other documents, instruments, certificates and opinions as Lender may reasonably require.

## Section 2.7 No Lender Liability; Relationship of the Parties

The relationship between Lender and Borrower is that of creditor and debtor only. Nothing in this Agreement or the other Loan Documents shall be construed to make Lender a partner, joint venturer, joint owner, agent, manager, operator or fiduciary of Borrower, the Contractor, the Architect or any other Person, or to make Lender liable for any obligation of Borrower or for any cost of the Project in excess of the Commitment. Lender's review or approval of the Plans and Specifications, the Approved Budget, the Draw Schedule, any Draw Request, any Approved Change Order, any lease or any other matter shall not constitute a representation or warranty by Lender as to the adequacy, feasibility, legality, quality or sufficiency of the same, and Borrower expressly assumes all risk relating thereto.

## Section 2.8 Borrower's Obligations Absolute

The Obligations of Borrower and each Guarantor shall be absolute, unconditional and irrevocable and shall not be affected by (a) any defect in the Project, the Plans and Specifications, the GMP Contract or the work of the Contractor, the Architect or any subcontractor or supplier; (b) any delay, suspension, withholding or reduction of any Advance; (c) any bankruptcy, insolvency or reorganization of the Contractor, the Architect, the Mezzanine Lender or any other Person; (d) any cost overrun, Defect or casualty; or (e) any setoff, counterclaim, defense or recoupment that Borrower may assert against Lender (other than a defense that the Obligations have been paid in full).

# ARTICLE 3 — INTEREST

## Section 3.1 Construction Rate

During the Construction Period, interest shall accrue on the outstanding principal balance of the Loan at the Construction Rate, computed daily on the basis of actual days elapsed over a 360-day year. As of the Effective Date, and assuming a Daily Simple SOFR rate of 4.35%, the Construction Rate would be 7.60% per annum.

## Section 3.2 Mini-Perm Rate

During the Mini-Perm Period, interest shall accrue on the outstanding principal balance of the Loan at the Mini-Perm Rate, computed daily on the basis of actual days elapsed over a 360-day year. As of the Effective Date, and assuming a Daily Simple SOFR rate of 4.35%, the Mini-Perm Rate would be 7.85% per annum.

## Section 3.3 SOFR Floor

Notwithstanding any change in Daily Simple SOFR, Daily Simple SOFR shall in no event be less than the SOFR Floor of one percent (1.00%) per annum for purposes of determining the Construction Rate or the Mini-Perm Rate. Accordingly, the Applicable Rate shall in no event be less than 4.25% per annum during the Construction Period or 4.50% per annum during the Mini-Perm Period.

## Section 3.4 Default Rate

From and after the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default (and after the occurrence of an Event of Default described in **Section 24.5**, automatically and without notice), all outstanding amounts of principal, and to the extent permitted by applicable law all accrued interest, fees and other Obligations, shall bear interest at the Default Rate, computed daily, payable on demand. The application of the Default Rate is not a penalty but a charge for the additional risk and expense of carrying an overdue obligation, and it is agreed to be just compensation therefor.

## Section 3.5 Computation; Notices

Interest shall be computed on the daily outstanding principal balance of the Loan. Lender shall, upon request, deliver to Borrower a statement of the amount of interest and fees due for any period; such statement shall be conclusive absent manifest error. Lender shall not be required to deliver any notice of a change in, or determination of, Daily Simple SOFR or the Applicable Rate.

## Section 3.6 Benchmark Replacement

(a) **Triggers.** If, at any time, Lender determines that (i) Daily Simple SOFR has been permanently or indefinitely discontinued or is no longer representative, (ii) the regulatory supervisor for the administrator of SOFR or the Relevant Governmental Body has made a public statement that SOFR is no longer representative or is to be discontinued, or (iii) the administrator of SOFR, its supervisory authority or a bankruptcy or insolvency official has declared SOFR to be unlawful or unworkable, then Lender and Borrower shall endeavor in good faith to establish a Benchmark Replacement consistent with the Alternative Reference Rates Committee's recommended best practices, including an appropriate term rate or a daily adjusted version of SOFR, a spread adjustment (which shall equal or be consistent with the applicable ARRC spread adjustment for the relevant tenor), and conforming changes to this Agreement and the Note.

(b) **Unilateral determination.** If, after thirty (30) days, Lender and Borrower have not agreed to a Benchmark Replacement, Lender may designate a Benchmark Replacement (including a spread adjustment, if any, and conforming changes) that is consistent with market practice for comparable commercial real estate construction facilities and is not adverse to Borrower in any material respect, and any such designation shall be binding on Borrower; *provided* that no such designation shall increase the Applicable Rate above the rate in effect on the date of such designation unless required to reflect the difference between SOFR and the successor rate plus the spread adjustment.

(c) **No compensation.** Borrower shall not be entitled to any payment or compensation solely as a result of any Benchmark Replacement, and the SOFR Floor shall continue to apply to any Benchmark Replacement (with the floor adjusted, if applicable, in a manner consistent with the ARRC recommendation for the successor rate).

## Section 3.7 Interest Rate Limitation

Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, the Note or any other Loan Document, in no event shall the amount of interest or any other charge constituting interest under applicable law (including 12 U.S.C. §85 or Chapter 24 of the North Carolina General Statutes) exceed the maximum rate permitted by applicable law (the "**Maximum Rate**"). If any such amount would exceed the Maximum Rate, the rate of interest shall be automatically reduced to the Maximum Rate, and any amount previously collected in excess of the Maximum Rate shall be, at Lender's option, applied to reduce the principal balance of the Loan or refunded to Borrower. To the extent permitted by law, all interest at any time contracted for, charged or received shall be amortized, prorated, allocated and spread over the full period of the Loan in accordance with 12 C.F.R. §160.5 (or any analogous law).

## Section 3.8 Inability to Determine Rate

If Lender determines that (a) adequate and reasonable means do not exist for ascertaining Daily Simple SOFR, or (b) Daily Simple SOFR is not available for any reason and no Benchmark Replacement has been established under **Section 3.6**, Lender shall promptly notify Borrower, and until such notice is withdrawn, the Applicable Rate shall be determined using the last available Daily Simple SOFR (but not less than the SOFR Floor), and Lender shall not be obligated to make Advances during such period if the determination of the Applicable Rate is impractical in Lender's reasonable judgment.

## RECITALS

A. B. ## Section 1.2 Interpretation

In this Agreement: (a) headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation; (b) the words "include," "includes" and "including" are deemed to be followed by "without limitation"; (c) references to Articles, Sections, Schedules and Exhibits are to Articles and Sections of, and Schedules and Exhibits to, this Agreement, each of which is incorporated herein by reference; (d) "hereof," "herein" and "hereunder" refer to this Agreement as a whole; (e) references to any statute, rule or regulation include any amendment, successor or re-codification thereof and the rules and regulations promulgated thereunder; (f) references to any document include such document as amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time in accordance with its terms and, where applicable, this Agreement; (g) the singular includes the plural and vice versa, and any gender includes all genders; (h) references to "$" or "dollars" are to the lawful currency of the United States; and (i) no presumption shall operate against the party that drafted this Agreement or any Loan Document.

## Section 1.3 Accounting Terms; Determinations

All accounting terms not specifically defined herein shall be construed in accordance with GAAP applied on a consistent basis. All determinations of the Applicable Rate, Daily Simple SOFR, the Benchmark Replacement, the Loan-to-Cost Ratio, the Loan-to-Value Ratio, DSCR, Combined DSCR and all other financial calculations shall be made by Lender in its reasonable discretion, in good faith, and shall be conclusive and binding on Borrower absent manifest error.

## Section 1.4 Day Count; Rounding

All interest under this Agreement and the Note shall be computed on the basis of actual days elapsed over a 360-day year. Any change in the Applicable Rate resulting from a change in Daily Simple SOFR shall become effective automatically on the day of such change, without notice to Borrower. Any determination of a rate of interest that would otherwise result in a fraction of one one-hundredth of one percent (0.01%) shall be rounded upward to the nearest one one-hundredth of one percent.

# ARTICLE 2 — THE LOAN

## Section 2.1 Commitment and Obligation to Advance

Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and the other Loan Documents, Lender agrees to make Advances to Borrower from time to time during the Construction Period (and, in the case of the Retainage release and the final portion of the Developer Fee, during the Mini-Perm Period) in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed at any time outstanding the Borrowing Base Availability, and in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed the Commitment. The Loan is a fully committed construction-to-mini-permanent facility. The Loan is **not** a revolving credit facility, and no amount repaid or prepaid may be reborrowed.

## Section 2.2 Purpose

The proceeds of the Loan shall be used solely (a) to pay or reimburse the hard costs, soft costs and financing costs of the Project set forth in the Approved Budget to the extent allocated to the Loan in the Approved Budget, (b) to fund the Interest Reserve, (c) to pay the Origination Fee to the extent permitted by **Section 5.1**, and (d) to pay such other costs of the Project as Lender may approve in writing. No proceeds of the Loan shall be used (i) to pay any distribution to any member of Borrower other than the Developer Fee to the extent permitted by **Section 11.6**, (ii) to pay any interest, principal, fee or other amount on the Mezzanine Loan, (iii) to pay any cost of the Project that is not set forth in the Approved Budget, (iv) to pay any cost of remediation of Hazardous Materials other than as expressly set forth in the Approved Budget, or (v) for any purpose that would violate any Anti-Corruption Law or any applicable sanctions regime, including those administered by OFAC.

## Section 2.3 Advances; Draw Schedule

The Loan shall be advanced in stages in accordance with the milestones, percentages of completion and amounts set forth in the Draw Schedule attached as **Exhibit C** (which supersedes the draw schedule set forth in Section 9.2 of the Term Sheet). The Draw Schedule is a schedule of anticipated disbursements and does not constitute a commitment by Lender to advance any amount other than in accordance with, and subject to, the conditions of **Article 9**. The aggregate amount of Advances shall not exceed the Commitment, and the final Advance (other than the release of Retainage) shall not exceed the amount necessary to pay the unpaid costs of the Project then due, less the Required Equity Contribution and all amounts funded by the Mezzanine Loan and by Equity Contributions.

## Section 2.4 Loan-to-Cost and Loan-to-Value Limitations; Equity Requirement

(a) **Borrowing Base Limitation.** Notwithstanding the Commitment, no Advance shall be made, and Borrower shall not be entitled to any Advance, to the extent that, after giving effect thereto, (i) the outstanding principal balance of the Loan would exceed the Borrowing Base Availability, (ii) the Loan-to-Cost Ratio would exceed eighty percent (80%), or (iii) the Loan-to-Value Ratio would exceed sixty-five percent (65%). Lender's determinations under this Section shall be made in good faith and shall be conclusive absent manifest error.

(b) **Required Equity.** On or before the Closing Date, Borrower shall have funded, and shall deliver evidence satisfactory to Lender (including bank statements, wire confirmations, and a source-of-funds certification in form satisfactory to Lender) of, Equity Contributions in an aggregate amount not less than the Required Equity Contribution. The Required Equity Contribution shall be funded from sources **other than** (i) the Mezzanine Loan or any proceeds thereof, (ii) Brightleaf Mezzanine Capital LLC, Brightleaf Investors Group LLC, Thomas R. Chen, or any Affiliate of any of the foregoing, (iii) any other financing or refinancing of the Property, or (iv) any borrowing that is secured, directly or indirectly, by the Property or by any interest in Borrower. Lender shall not be obligated to make any Advance (other than the Closing Advance) unless and until the Required Equity Contribution has been deposited and fully applied to Project Costs as contemplated by this Section.

(c) **Equity Escrow Account.** The Required Equity Contribution shall be deposited into a segregated, Lender-controlled account (the "**Equity Escrow Account**") at Closing, shall be applied to Project Costs before any Advance (other than the Closing Advance) is made, and shall be subject to a Pledged Account Agreement. Upon application of the Required Equity Contribution to Project Costs, the Borrowing Base Availability shall be computed giving effect to Total Project Costs as reduced by the portion of the Required Equity Contribution so applied, and the Commitment shall be correspondingly and permanently reduced so that the Loan-to-Cost Ratio does not exceed eighty percent (80%) at any time. Borrower and Lender shall record the resulting amount of the Commitment on the Closing Statement.

(d) **Conforming Amendment.** If, at or before Closing, the Approved Budget is conformed to include the Refinancing Payoff as a Project Cost in accordance with **Section 11.2**, then the Required Equity Contribution and the Commitment shall be recomputed on the conformed Approved Budget, and the Loan-to-Cost Ratio shall be tested against the conformed Total Project Costs; *provided* that in no event shall the Required Equity Contribution be less than $2,140,000.

(e) **No Waiver.** Any failure of the Loan to satisfy the limitations of this Section shall not constitute a waiver by Lender, and Lender may condition any Advance on the deposit of additional Equity Contributions in amounts sufficient to satisfy such limitations.

## Section 2.5 The Note

The Loan shall be evidenced by the Note, dated as of the Closing Date, payable to the order of Lender in the principal amount of the Commitment, bearing interest as provided in **Article 3** and repayable as provided in **Article 4**. The Note shall be entitled to the benefits of this Agreement and the other Loan Documents.

## Section 2.6 Loan Documents

The Obligations shall be secured by, and Borrower shall execute and deliver at Closing (or, with respect to any later-arising document, when required hereunder), the following Loan Documents, each in form and substance satisfactory to Lender and its counsel: (a) this Agreement; (b) the Note; (c) the Deed of Trust, Assignment of Rents, Security Agreement and Fixture Filing; (d) the Assignment of Rents and Leases; (e) the Security Agreement and UCC-1 financing statements; (f) the Assignments of Development Documents (including the GMP Contract and the Architect's Agreement); (g) the Collateral Assignment of Insurance Proceeds and Condemnation Awards; (h) the Pledge Agreements and Pledged Account Agreements; (i) the Guaranties; (j) the Environmental Indemnity; (k) the Intercreditor Agreement; (l) the Non-Consolidation Opinion; and (m) such other documents, instruments, certificates and opinions as Lender may reasonably require.

## Section 2.7 No Lender Liability; Relationship of the Parties

The relationship between Lender and Borrower is that of creditor and debtor only. Nothing in this Agreement or the other Loan Documents shall be construed to make Lender a partner, joint venturer, joint owner, agent, manager, operator or fiduciary of Borrower, the Contractor, the Architect or any other Person, or to make Lender liable for any obligation of Borrower or for any cost of the Project in excess of the Commitment. Lender's review or approval of the Plans and Specifications, the Approved Budget, the Draw Schedule, any Draw Request, any Approved Change Order, any lease or any other matter shall not constitute a representation or warranty by Lender as to the adequacy, feasibility, legality, quality or sufficiency of the same, and Borrower expressly assumes all risk relating thereto.

## Section 2.8 Borrower's Obligations Absolute

The Obligations of Borrower and each Guarantor shall be absolute, unconditional and irrevocable and shall not be affected by (a) any defect in the Project, the Plans and Specifications, the GMP Contract or the work of the Contractor, the Architect or any subcontractor or supplier; (b) any delay, suspension, withholding or reduction of any Advance; (c) any bankruptcy, insolvency or reorganization of the Contractor, the Architect, the Mezzanine Lender or any other Person; (d) any cost overrun, Defect or casualty; or (e) any setoff, counterclaim, defense or recoupment that Borrower may assert against Lender (other than a defense that the Obligations have been paid in full).

# ARTICLE 3 — INTEREST

## Section 3.1 Construction Rate

During the Construction Period, interest shall accrue on the outstanding principal balance of the Loan at the Construction Rate, computed daily on the basis of actual days elapsed over a 360-day year. As of the Effective Date, and assuming a Daily Simple SOFR rate of 4.35%, the Construction Rate would be 7.60% per annum.

## Section 3.2 Mini-Perm Rate

During the Mini-Perm Period, interest shall accrue on the outstanding principal balance of the Loan at the Mini-Perm Rate, computed daily on the basis of actual days elapsed over a 360-day year. As of the Effective Date, and assuming a Daily Simple SOFR rate of 4.35%, the Mini-Perm Rate would be 7.85% per annum.

## Section 3.3 SOFR Floor

Notwithstanding any change in Daily Simple SOFR, Daily Simple SOFR shall in no event be less than the SOFR Floor of one percent (1.00%) per annum for purposes of determining the Construction Rate or the Mini-Perm Rate. Accordingly, the Applicable Rate shall in no event be less than 4.25% per annum during the Construction Period or 4.50% per annum during the Mini-Perm Period.

## Section 3.4 Default Rate

From and after the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default (and after the occurrence of an Event of Default described in **Section 24.5**, automatically and without notice), all outstanding amounts of principal, and to the extent permitted by applicable law all accrued interest, fees and other Obligations, shall bear interest at the Default Rate, computed daily, payable on demand. The application of the Default Rate is not a penalty but a charge for the additional risk and expense of carrying an overdue obligation, and it is agreed to be just compensation therefor.

## Section 3.5 Computation; Notices

Interest shall be computed on the daily outstanding principal balance of the Loan. Lender shall, upon request, deliver to Borrower a statement of the amount of interest and fees due for any period; such statement shall be conclusive absent manifest error. Lender shall not be required to deliver any notice of a change in, or determination of, Daily Simple SOFR or the Applicable Rate.

## Section 3.6 Benchmark Replacement

(a) **Triggers.** If, at any time, Lender determines that (i) Daily Simple SOFR has been permanently or indefinitely discontinued or is no longer representative, (ii) the regulatory supervisor for the administrator of SOFR or the Relevant Governmental Body has made a public statement that SOFR is no longer representative or is to be discontinued, or (iii) the administrator of SOFR, its supervisory authority or a bankruptcy or insolvency official has declared SOFR to be unlawful or unworkable, then Lender and Borrower shall endeavor in good faith to establish a Benchmark Replacement consistent with the Alternative Reference Rates Committee's recommended best practices, including an appropriate term rate or a daily adjusted version of SOFR, a spread adjustment (which shall equal or be consistent with the applicable ARRC spread adjustment for the relevant tenor), and conforming changes to this Agreement and the Note.

(b) **Unilateral determination.** If, after thirty (30) days, Lender and Borrower have not agreed to a Benchmark Replacement, Lender may designate a Benchmark Replacement (including a spread adjustment, if any, and conforming changes) that is consistent with market practice for comparable commercial real estate construction facilities and is not adverse to Borrower in any material respect, and any such designation shall be binding on Borrower; *provided* that no such designation shall increase the Applicable Rate above the rate in effect on the date of such designation unless required to reflect the difference between SOFR and the successor rate plus the spread adjustment.

(c) **No compensation.** Borrower shall not be entitled to any payment or compensation solely as a result of any Benchmark Replacement, and the SOFR Floor shall continue to apply to any Benchmark Replacement (with the floor adjusted, if applicable, in a manner consistent with the ARRC recommendation for the successor rate).

## Section 3.7 Interest Rate Limitation

Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, the Note or any other Loan Document, in no event shall the amount of interest or any other charge constituting interest under applicable law (including 12 U.S.C. §85 or Chapter 24 of the North Carolina General Statutes) exceed the maximum rate permitted by applicable law (the "**Maximum Rate**"). If any such amount would exceed the Maximum Rate, the rate of interest shall be automatically reduced to the Maximum Rate, and any amount previously collected in excess of the Maximum Rate shall be, at Lender's option, applied to reduce the principal balance of the Loan or refunded to Borrower. To the extent permitted by law, all interest at any time contracted for, charged or received shall be amortized, prorated, allocated and spread over the full period of the Loan in accordance with 12 C.F.R. §160.5 (or any analogous law).

## Section 3.8 Inability to Determine Rate

If Lender determines that (a) adequate and reasonable means do not exist for ascertaining Daily Simple SOFR, or (b) Daily Simple SOFR is not available for any reason and no Benchmark Replacement has been established under **Section 3.6**, Lender shall promptly notify Borrower, and until such notice is withdrawn, the Applicable Rate shall be determined using the last available Daily Simple SOFR (but not less than the SOFR Floor), and Lender shall not be obligated to make Advances during such period if the determination of the Applicable Rate is impractical in Lender's reasonable judgment.

# ARTICLE 4 — PAYMENTS

## Section 4.1 Payment of Interest

Interest on the outstanding principal balance of the Loan shall be payable monthly in arrears on the first (1st) Business Day of each calendar month, commencing on the first (1st) Business Day of the first full calendar month following the Closing Date. During the Construction Period, and for so long as sufficient funds remain in the Interest Reserve Account, each monthly payment of interest shall be funded by Lender from the Interest Reserve Account in accordance with **Article 8**. From and after the date on which the Interest Reserve is exhausted, and throughout the Mini-Perm Period, all interest shall be paid by Borrower from its own funds (subject to the Carry Guaranty).

## Section 4.2 Payment of Principal

The outstanding principal balance of the Loan, together with all accrued and unpaid interest, fees, costs and other Obligations, shall be due and payable in full on the Maturity Date, without notice, presentment, demand or protest, all of which are waived by Borrower. The Loan is interest-only; no scheduled amortization shall apply, except that the outstanding principal balance may be reduced by optional prepayments permitted under **Article 7** and by mandatory prepayments required under **Section 7.2**.

## Section 4.3 Manner of Payment

All payments shall be made in immediately available funds, in lawful currency of the United States, without setoff, counterclaim, deduction or withholding of any kind, to the account designated by Lender in writing (or by wire transfer in accordance with Lender's written instructions). Any payment received after 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time on a Business Day shall be deemed received on the next Business Day. If any payment is due on a day that is not a Business Day, such payment shall be due on the next succeeding Business Day, and interest shall continue to accrue during such extension.

## Section 4.4 No Setoff; Absolute Obligation

Borrower's obligation to pay all amounts due under the Loan Documents is absolute and unconditional. Borrower waives any right of setoff, counterclaim, defense or recoupment with respect to any payment due, and shall not withhold or delay any payment by reason of any dispute with Lender, the Contractor, the Architect, the Mezzanine Lender or any other Person.

## Section 4.5 Application of Payments

All payments received by Lender shall be applied in the following order of priority: (a) to reimburse Lender for any costs, expenses and indemnities (including reasonable attorneys' fees) incurred in connection with the Loan; (b) to late charges and fees; (c) to accrued and unpaid interest (including interest at the Default Rate); (d) to the outstanding principal balance of the Loan; and (e) to any other Obligations. Notwithstanding the foregoing, during the continuance of an Event of Default, Lender may apply payments in any order it determines in its discretion.

## Section 4.6 Payments Received from Third Parties

Lender may, but shall not be obligated to, accept payments from any Guarantor or other Person on account of the Obligations, and any such payment shall be applied as provided in **Section 4.5** without releasing Borrower or any Guarantor from liability.

# ARTICLE 5 — FEES

## Section 5.1 Origination Fee

Borrower shall pay to Lender at Closing a non-refundable origination fee equal to one percent (1.00%) of the original principal amount of the Loan, being $475,000 (the "**Origination Fee**"). The Origination Fee may, at Borrower's election and to the extent reflected in the Approved Budget (line item 4.02), be funded from the proceeds of the Loan as part of the Closing Advance.

## Section 5.2 Exit Fee

Borrower shall pay to Lender a non-refundable exit fee (the "**Exit Fee**") determined as follows: (a) if the Loan is repaid in full at any time during the Construction Period, an amount equal to one-half of one percent (0.50%) of the outstanding principal balance of the Loan immediately prior to such repayment; (b) if the Loan is repaid in full during the first six (6) months of the Mini-Perm Period, an amount equal to one-quarter of one percent (0.25%) of the outstanding principal balance of the Loan immediately prior to such repayment; and (c) no Exit Fee shall be payable if the Loan is repaid in full after the first six (6) months of the Mini-Perm Period or after the Mini-Perm Maturity Date. For the avoidance of doubt, the Exit Fee shall not be payable in connection with a refinancing of the Loan by Lender or any Affiliate of Lender.

## Section 5.3 Unused Line Fee

Borrower shall pay to Lender a fee equal to one-quarter of one percent (0.25%) per annum on the average daily undrawn amount of the Commitment, computed on the basis of actual days elapsed over a 360-day year, payable quarterly in arrears commencing with the first Business Day of the first full calendar quarter following the Closing Date and continuing through the earlier of (a) the date on which the Loan is fully advanced and (b) the Maturity Date. For purposes of this Section, amounts held in the Interest Reserve Account and the Equity Escrow Account shall be deemed drawn, and the undrawn amount of the Commitment shall exclude the amount of the Commitment permanently reduced under **Section 2.4(c)**.

## Section 5.4 Extension Fee

If Borrower validly exercises the Extension Option, Borrower shall pay to Lender, on or before the Construction Maturity Date, a non-refundable extension fee equal to one-quarter of one percent (0.25%) of the outstanding principal balance of the Loan as of the date of such payment.

## Section 5.5 Late Charge

If any installment of principal, interest, a fee or any other amount (other than an amount that is subject to a permitted grace period under **Section 24.1**) is not paid in full within five (5) days after its due date, Borrower shall pay to Lender, upon demand, a late charge equal to five percent (5.00%) of the overdue amount. Borrower acknowledges that such late charge represents a fair and reasonable estimate of the costs and administrative burdens Lender will incur as a result of late payment and does not constitute a penalty; *provided* that such charge shall be subject to **Section 3.7**.

## Section 5.6 Other Fees and Charges

Borrower shall pay (a) all fees and charges of the Disbursement Agent, the construction inspector, the appraiser, the environmental consultant and any other third-party consultant engaged by Lender in connection with the Loan, (b) all recording, filing, endorsement and title charges, and (c) all administrative, servicing, wire-transfer, processing and similar fees customarily charged by Lender for administration of construction facilities. Lender's schedule of such fees as in effect at Closing is attached as **Schedule 5.6**.

## Section 5.7 Fees Non-Refundable

The Origination Fee, the Exit Fee, the Unused Line Fee, the Extension Fee and all other fees paid under this Article shall be non-refundable when paid, except as expressly provided in this Agreement or as required by applicable law.

# ARTICLE 6 — MATURITY AND EXTENSION

## Section 6.1 Maturity; Transition to Mini-Perm

(a) **Construction Period.** The entire outstanding principal balance of the Loan, together with all accrued interest and other Obligations, shall be due and payable on the Construction Maturity Date, unless Borrower satisfies the conditions of **Section 6.1(b)** and the Loan converts to the Mini-Perm Period.

(b) **Conversion Conditions.** The Loan shall convert to the Mini-Perm Period if, on or before the Construction Maturity Date, each of the following conditions is satisfied (or waived by Lender in writing): (i) no Default or Event of Default exists; (ii) Substantial Completion has been achieved and a certificate of occupancy has been issued for all residential units, retail bays and the parking garage; (iii) the Vapor Mitigation System has been installed, verified and accepted by NCDEQ, and all other conditions of the NFA Letter then due have been satisfied; (iv) the Interest Reserve is not then subject to an unremedied Interest Reserve Shortfall; (v) Lender has received evidence of the required insurance, a current Rent Roll (to the extent any leases are in place) and a then-current budget for the Mini-Perm Period; (vi) the Required Equity Contribution has been fully deposited and applied; and (vii) no Construction Delay Default has occurred and is continuing.

(c) **Extension of Construction Maturity Date.** If Substantial Completion has not occurred by July 1, 2027, Lender may, in its sole discretion, extend the Construction Maturity Date to the Outside Completion Date; *provided* that any such extension shall not constitute a waiver of any Construction Delay Default and shall be subject to Borrower's payment of a fee of 0.15% of the outstanding principal balance. If the Construction Maturity Date so extended, the Mini-Perm Maturity Date and the Extended Maturity Date shall each be extended by a like period.

## Section 6.2 Extension Option

Borrower shall have one (1) option (the "**Extension Option**") to extend the Mini-Perm Maturity Date from August 28, 2028 to the Extended Maturity Date, subject to the satisfaction of each of the conditions set forth in **Exhibit F** (together with such other customary conditions as Lender may reasonably establish) and the payment of the Extension Fee. The Extension Option is personal to Borrower and may not be exercised following the occurrence of an Event of Default or after March 1, 2028.

## Section 6.3 Relations to Mini-Perm; No Further Extension

The Mini-Perm Period is not a new or additional loan and does not constitute a novation or refinancing of the Loan. Borrower acknowledges that Lender's agreement to the Mini-Perm Period is conditioned upon the representations and covenants in this Agreement. Borrower shall have no right to any further extension of the Maturity Date beyond the Extended Maturity Date, and Lender shall have no obligation to refinance the Loan at or after the Maturity Date.

## Section 6.4 Take-Out Financing Cooperation

Borrower shall use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain a permanent take-out refinancing or sale of the Property. Not later than one hundred twenty (120) days prior to the then-current Maturity Date, Borrower shall deliver to Lender a written plan (including term sheets, lender identification, or marketing materials) reasonably satisfactory to Lender demonstrating Borrower's progress toward repayment of the Loan on or before the Maturity Date. Failure to deliver such a plan shall not itself constitute an Event of Default but shall be a factor considered by Lender in evaluating any request for an extension.

# ARTICLE 7 — PREPAYMENT

## Section 7.1 Optional Prepayment

Borrower may prepay the Loan in whole or in part at any time without premium or penalty, other than payment of the Exit Fee to the extent payable under **Section 5.2**, accrued interest to the date of prepayment, and all other Obligations then due. Borrower shall give Lender not less than five (5) Business Days' prior written notice of any optional prepayment.

## Section 7.2 Mandatory Prepayments

Borrower shall prepay the Loan, without premium or penalty (other than the Exit Fee to the extent payable), in the following circumstances: (a) upon receipt of any Net Proceeds of casualty insurance or condemnation that Lender determines not to make available for restoration under **Section 20.6**, in an amount equal to such Net Proceeds; (b) upon any sale, transfer or other disposition of the Property or any material portion thereof or interest therein permitted under this Agreement (including any permitted transfer requiring Lender's consent that is conditioned on a prepayment), in the amount of the Net Proceeds thereof; (c) upon the incurrence of any Indebtedness not constituting Permitted Indebtedness, in the amount of the net proceeds thereof; (d) upon any DSCR cure required under **Section 16.3**; and (e) upon any determination by Lender that Borrower has received a capital contribution in excess of the amounts contemplated by the Approved Budget, to the extent required to maintain compliance with **Section 16.1** or **Section 16.2**.

## Section 7.3 Reduction of Commitment

Any prepayment of the Loan shall permanently reduce the Commitment by the amount so prepaid, and no portion of any amount repaid may be reborrowed. Upon Lender's demand, Borrower shall execute such confirmations of the reduction of the Commitment as Lender may reasonably request.

## Section 7.4 Prepayment of Other Debt

Borrower shall not prepay, defease, redeem or otherwise satisfy the Mezzanine Loan or any other Indebtedness (other than Permitted Indebtedness described in **Section 1.1**, clause (c) or (d)) without Lender's prior written consent.

# ARTICLE 8 — INTEREST RESERVE

## Section 8.1 Funding of Interest Reserve

At Closing, Lender shall fund from the proceeds of the Closing Advance an interest reserve in the amount of $4,850,000 (the "**Interest Reserve**"), to be held in a segregated sub-account of the Loan (the "**Interest Reserve Account**") established with Lender or the Disbursement Agent and subject to a Pledged Account Agreement. The Interest Reserve is part of the Loan and bears interest at the Applicable Rate; interest accruing on the Interest Reserve itself shall be paid from the Interest Reserve Account.

## Section 8.2 Application of Interest Reserve

Amounts in the Interest Reserve Account shall be disbursed solely to pay interest accruing on the outstanding principal balance of the Loan during the Construction Period. Lender is authorized to withdraw from the Interest Reserve Account on each interest payment date the amount of interest then due, without further request or authorization from Borrower. No amounts in the Interest Reserve Account shall be available for any other purpose, and Borrower shall have no right to withdraw or direct the application of such amounts.

## Section 8.3 Interest Reserve Shortfall; Replenishment

(a) Borrower acknowledges that, based on the draw timing reflected in the Draw Schedule and a Daily Simple SOFR rate of 4.35% per annum (the rate in effect on the date of the Credit Memorandum), the projected aggregate interest accruing during the thirty (30) month Construction Period is approximately $5,211,500, which exceeds the Interest Reserve by approximately $361,500. Borrower further acknowledges that the draw schedule analysis delivered with the Approved Budget projected aggregate interest of $4,628,675 and a surplus of $221,325 only on the assumption of a Daily Simple SOFR rate of 3.50% per annum, which is below the rate in effect on the date of this Agreement.

(b) If at any time the balance of the Interest Reserve Account is or is projected to be insufficient to pay interest through the Construction Maturity Date (an "**Interest Reserve Shortfall**"), Borrower shall, within five (5) Business Days after written notice from Lender, deposit into the Interest Reserve Account, in immediately available funds and from sources other than the proceeds of the Loan or the Mezzanine Loan, an amount sufficient to eliminate the Interest Reserve Shortfall. Amounts so deposited shall be applied as provided in **Section 8.2** and shall not reduce the Commitment or be credited against any other obligation of Borrower.

(c) At Lender's election, any unremedied Interest Reserve Shortfall may be funded by Lender (without any obligation to do so) and the amount so funded shall be added to the outstanding principal balance of the Loan, shall bear interest at the Default Rate until reimbursed, and shall be secured by the Loan Documents.

## Section 8.4 Adequacy Testing

Lender shall test the adequacy of the Interest Reserve at each Draw Request and not less often than quarterly, by comparing (a) the balance of the Interest Reserve Account with (b) the projected interest accruing through the earlier of (i) the next anticipated Draw date and (ii) the date ninety (90) days after the date of the test, based on the then-current Daily Simple SOFR, the Applicable Rate and the projected outstanding principal balance. If the test is not satisfied, Lender may condition any pending Advance on Borrower's deposit of additional funds into the Interest Reserve Account under **Section 8.3(b)**.

## Section 8.5 Monthly Reconciliation

Within fifteen (15) days after the end of each calendar month during the Construction Period, Borrower shall deliver to Lender a reconciliation of the Interest Reserve Account showing (a) the opening balance, (b) interest charged during the month, (c) any deposits, (d) the closing balance, and (e) Borrower's projection of interest accruing through the Construction Maturity Date, together with the SOFR assumptions used.

## Section 8.6 Rate Protection

If at any time (a) Daily Simple SOFR exceeds 5.00% per annum, (b) Lender reasonably determines that the Interest Reserve will be exhausted more than one hundred eighty (180) days before the Construction Maturity Date, or (c) the DSCR on a pro forma basis would be less than 1.25x, Lender may require Borrower, within thirty (30) days, to obtain and maintain an interest rate cap agreement on terms (including notional amount, strike rate, term and counterparty rating) reasonably satisfactory to Lender, at Borrower's sole cost, and to collaterally assign such cap to Lender. Borrower's failure to do so after demand shall constitute an Event of Default under **Section 24.3**.

## Section 8.7 Interest Reserve Is Not a Funded Reserve

The Interest Reserve is a funded accounting reserve within the Loan and is not a trust fund, escrow or deposit for the benefit of Borrower. Amounts in the Interest Reserve Account remain the property of Lender until disbursed, and Borrower has no interest therein except the right to have such amounts applied as provided in this Article.

# ARTICLE 9 — ADVANCES; CONDITIONS TO LENDING

## Section 9.1 Draw Requests

Borrower shall request each Progress Advance by delivering to Lender, not less than fifteen (15) days prior to the requested funding date, a draw request in the form attached as **Exhibit G** (a "**Draw Request**"), signed by the Managing Member of Borrower and accompanied by each of the following, in each case in form and substance satisfactory to Lender:

(a) an AIA Application and Certificate for Payment (Form G702) and Continuation Sheet (Form G703) certified by the Architect and the Contractor;

(c) a certification from the third-party construction inspector engaged by Lender that the applicable milestone has been achieved, the percentage of completion stated in the Draw Request is accurate, and the remaining funds are adequate to complete the Project;

(d) partial lien waivers and releases, in statutory form under N.C.G.S. Chapter 44A, from the Contractor, the Architect and all subcontractors and materialmen for all work performed and materials furnished through the date of the Draw Request (including, for the first Draw Request after Closing, the waivers and releases described in **Section 12.6**);

All Advances shall be disbursed through the Disbursement Agent in accordance with Lender's written disbursement instructions and the Disbursement Agent's closing instructions, and shall be funded directly to the Contractor, the Architect, the applicable vendor or consultant, the Interest Reserve Account or such other payee as Lender may approve. No Advance shall be deemed made until funds are actually disbursed by the Disbursement Agent.

Lender may suspend, withhold, condition or reduce any Advance, without liability to Borrower, if (a) any condition in **Section 9.1** or **Section 9.2** is not satisfied; (b) Lender reasonably determines that the undisbursed portion of the Loan, together with Retainage, contingency and committed Equity Contributions, is insufficient to complete the Project free and clear of liens; (c) a material deviation from the Plans and Specifications or the Approved Budget has occurred; (d) any mechanics' or materialmen's lien is filed against the Property and is not bonded off or released within thirty (30) days; (e) Borrower fails to comply with the NFA Letter, the Soil Management Plan or any Environmental Law; (f) a Construction Delay Default has occurred; or (g) Lender reasonably determines that the Project cannot be completed by the Outside Completion Date. Any suspension under this Section shall not constitute a default by Lender or excuse Borrower from any obligation, and interest shall continue to accrue on all outstanding amounts.

## Section 9.7 Cost Overruns; Borrower's Completion Obligation

Borrower shall complete the Project in accordance with the Plans and Specifications, the Approved Budget and the Draw Schedule, free and clear of all Liens other than Permitted Exceptions, on or before the Outside Completion Date, regardless of the availability of any Advance. Lender shall have no obligation to increase the Commitment or to advance funds to cover any cost overrun.

## Section 9.8 Equity First

Borrower's Equity Contributions (including the Required Equity Contribution held in the Equity Escrow Account) shall be applied to Project Costs before any Progress Advance is made, other than the Closing Advance. Borrower shall deliver a written certification with each Draw Request of the amount of Equity Contributions applied to date.

## Section 9.9 Advances Not a Waiver; No Obligation to Continue

No Advance shall constitute a waiver of any condition, Default or Event of Default, whether known or unknown to Lender. Lender's making of any Advance with knowledge of a Default or Event of Default shall not constitute a waiver thereof, and Lender may thereafter declare an Event of Default and exercise its remedies on the basis thereof.

## Section 9.10 Advances to Cure Defaults; Protective Advances

If Borrower fails to perform any covenant, or if Lender reasonably determines that it is necessary to protect its interest in the Property, Lender may (but shall not be obligated to) make Advances or incur costs to perform such covenant or protect such interest, including payment of taxes, insurance, liens, completion costs, environmental remediation costs and legal fees. All amounts so advanced or incurred shall constitute Obligations, shall bear interest at the Default Rate from the date incurred until reimbursed, and shall be secured by the Loan Documents, but shall not be deemed to increase the Commitment or to waive any Default.

# ARTICLE 4 — PAYMENTS

## Section 4.1 Payment of Interest

Interest on the outstanding principal balance of the Loan shall be payable monthly in arrears on the first (1st) Business Day of each calendar month, commencing on the first (1st) Business Day of the first full calendar month following the Closing Date. During the Construction Period, and for so long as sufficient funds remain in the Interest Reserve Account, each monthly payment of interest shall be funded by Lender from the Interest Reserve Account in accordance with **Article 8**. The outstanding principal balance of the Loan, together with all accrued and unpaid interest, fees, costs and other Obligations, shall be due and payable in full on the Maturity Date, without notice, presentment, demand or protest, all of which are waived by Borrower. The Loan is interest-only; no scheduled amortization shall apply, except that the outstanding principal balance may be reduced by optional prepayments permitted under **Article 7** and by mandatory prepayments required under **Section 7.2**.

All payments shall be made in immediately available funds, in lawful currency of the United States, without setoff, counterclaim, deduction or withholding of any kind, to the account designated by Lender in writing (or by wire transfer in accordance with Lender's written instructions). Any payment received after 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time on a Business Day shall be deemed received on the next Business Day. If any payment is due on a day that is not a Business Day, such payment shall be due on the next succeeding Business Day, and interest shall continue to accrue during such extension.

Borrower's obligation to pay all amounts due under the Loan Documents is absolute and unconditional. ## Section 5.3 Unused Line Fee

Borrower shall pay to Lender a fee equal to one-quarter of one percent (0.25%) per annum on the average daily undrawn amount of the Commitment, computed on the basis of actual days elapsed over a 360-day year, payable quarterly in arrears commencing with the first Business Day of the first full calendar quarter following the Closing Date and continuing through the earlier of (a) the date on which the Loan is fully advanced and (b) the Maturity Date. No inspection, and no approval of a Draw Request, shall constitute a waiver of any Default or of any obligation of Borrower, or a representation by Lender as to the quality or adequacy of the work.

## Section 9.5 Disbursement Mechanics

All Advances shall be disbursed through the Disbursement Agent in accordance with Lender's written disbursement instructions and the Disbursement Agent's closing instructions, and shall be funded directly to the Contractor, the Architect, the applicable vendor or consultant, the Interest Reserve Account or such other payee as Lender may approve. Borrower hereby irrevocably authorizes and directs Lender to disburse the proceeds of the Loan in accordance with this Section. No Advance shall be deemed made until funds are actually disbursed by the Disbursement Agent.

## Section 9.6 Suspension and Withholding

Lender may suspend, withhold, condition or reduce any Advance, without liability to Borrower, if (a) any condition in **Section 9.1** or **Section 9.2** is not satisfied; (b) Lender reasonably determines that the undisbursed portion of the Loan, together with Retainage, contingency and committed Equity Contributions, is insufficient to complete the Project free and clear of liens; (c) a material deviation from the Plans and Specifications or the Approved Budget has occurred; (d) any mechanics' or materialmen's lien is filed against the Property and is not bonded off or released within thirty (30) days; (e) Borrower fails to comply with the NFA Letter, the Soil Management Plan or any Environmental Law; (f) a Construction Delay Default has occurred; or (g) Lender reasonably determines that the Project cannot be completed by the Outside Completion Date. Any suspension under this Section shall not constitute a default by Lender or excuse Borrower from any obligation, and interest shall continue to accrue on all outstanding amounts.

## Section 9.7 Cost Overruns; Borrower's Completion Obligation

Borrower shall complete the Project in accordance with the Plans and Specifications, the Approved Budget and the Draw Schedule, free and clear of all Liens other than Permitted Exceptions, on or before the Outside Completion Date, regardless of the availability of any Advance. All costs of the Project in excess of the Loan proceeds, Retainage, contingency and the Required Equity Contribution shall be funded by Borrower from Equity Contributions or other sources approved by Lender, and shall be deposited with Lender (or applied directly to such costs) before Lender shall be obligated to make any further Advance. Lender shall have no obligation to increase the Commitment or to advance funds to cover any cost overrun.

## Section 9.8 Equity First

Borrower's Equity Contributions (including the Required Equity Contribution held in the Equity Escrow Account) shall be applied to Project Costs before any Progress Advance is made, other than the Closing Advance. Borrower shall deliver a written certification with each Draw Request of the amount of Equity Contributions applied to date.

## Section 9.9 Advances Not a Waiver; No Obligation to Continue

No Advance shall constitute a waiver of any condition, Default or Event of Default, whether known or unknown to Lender. Lender's making of any Advance with knowledge of a Default or Event of Default shall not constitute a waiver thereof, and Lender may thereafter declare an Event of Default and exercise its remedies on the basis thereof.

## Section 9.10 Advances to Cure Defaults; Protective Advances

If Borrower fails to perform any covenant, or if Lender reasonably determines that it is necessary to protect its interest in the Property, Lender may (but shall not be obligated to) make Advances or incur costs to perform such covenant or protect such interest, including payment of taxes, insurance, liens, completion costs, environmental remediation costs and legal fees. All amounts so advanced or incurred shall constitute Obligations, shall bear interest at the Default Rate from the date incurred until reimbursed, and shall be secured by the Loan Documents, but shall not be deemed to increase the Commitment or to waive any Default.
