# ARTICLE 16 — FINANCIAL COVENANTS

## Section 16.1 Loan-to-Value Ratio

The LTV shall not exceed sixty-five percent (65%) at any time, tested (a) at Closing, (b) at the commencement of the Mini-Perm Period, (c) upon any reappraisal under **Section 16.9**, and (d) annually thereafter. Borrower acknowledges that the LTV as of the Effective Date, based on the Appraisal, is 65.25% on an as-completed basis ($47,500,000 ÷ $72,800,000) and 62.34% on an as-stabilized basis ($47,500,000 ÷ $76,200,000), and that the as-completed LTV exceeds the 65% limit by approximately $180,000 of principal. At or before Closing, Borrower shall either (i) reduce the principal amount of the Loan by $180,000, or (ii) deposit additional Equity Contributions in an amount sufficient to reduce the Loan-to-Value Ratio to not more than 65%, or (iii) deliver a reappraisal satisfactory to Lender demonstrating compliance.

## Section 16.2 Loan-to-Cost Ratio

The LTC shall not exceed eighty percent (80%) at any time, tested at Closing and at each Advance with reference to Total Project Costs as then reflected in the Approved Budget. Borrower acknowledges that, without giving effect to the Required Equity Contribution and the conforming of the Approved Budget under **Section 11.2**, the LTC is 83.77% ($47,500,000 ÷ $56,700,000).

## Section 16.3 Minimum DSCR

(a) **Test.** The DSCR shall not be less than 1.25x, tested (i) at the commencement of the Mini-Perm Period, calculated on a pro forma basis using Stabilized NOI and Senior Debt Service (and not on the basis of actual trailing twelve-month net operating income, which the parties acknowledge will not be meaningful until the Project has been operating and leasing for a reasonable period), (ii) at the first anniversary of Substantial Completion, (iii) annually thereafter, and (iv) upon any reappraisal under **Section 16.9**.

(b) **Cure.** If the DSCR is less than 1.25x at any test date, Borrower shall, within thirty (30) days after written notice from Lender, at Lender's election either (i) prepay the Loan in an amount sufficient to restore the DSCR to not less than 1.25x, or (ii) deposit cash collateral with Lender in an amount determined by Lender to be sufficient to restore the DSCR to not less than 1.25x, to be held in a pledged account and applied to the Obligations in accordance with Lender's instructions. Borrower's failure to cure within such period shall constitute an Event of Default under **Section 24.3**.

## Section 16.4 Combined Debt Service Coverage

(a) **Test.** From and after the first anniversary of Substantial Completion, the Combined DSCR shall not be less than 1.10x, tested annually. Borrower acknowledges that, based on Stabilized NOI of $4,876,800, Senior Debt Service of $3,728,750 (interest only at 7.85%) and Mezzanine Debt Service of approximately $1,150,000 per annum (12.50% on a $9,200,000 balance, before giving effect to paid-in-kind accrual), the Combined DSCR as of the Effective Date would be approximately 1.00x, and that, giving effect to the accrual of paid-in-kind interest on the Mezzanine Loan during the Construction Period (which would increase the Mezzanine Loan balance to approximately $12,075,000 by the Construction Maturity Date on a simple-interest basis), the Combined DSCR would be approximately 0.93x. The parties acknowledge that the Financial Covenants and the take-out strategy depend upon (i) the Mezzanine Lender's agreement to defer or capitalize a substantial portion of its interest, (ii) achievement of NOI in excess of the Appraisal's projection, or (iii) repayment or restructuring of the Mezzanine Loan at or before the Mini-Perm Period, and Borrower shall deliver to Lender, as a condition to conversion to the Mini-Perm Period, evidence reasonably satisfactory to Lender that the Combined DSCR will be satisfied or that the Mezzanine Loan will be repaid or restructured.

(b) **Cure.** If the Combined DSCR is less than 1.10x, Borrower shall, within thirty (30) days after notice, either (i) cause the Mezzanine Loan to be repaid, reduced or restructured so as to restore compliance, (ii) prepay the Loan in an amount sufficient to restore compliance, or (iii) deposit cash collateral with Lender in an amount sufficient to restore compliance.

Borrower's net worth, determined in accordance with GAAP, shall not at any time be less than $12,000,000, tested annually within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of each Fiscal Year and upon Lender's reasonable request. # ARTICLE 17 — NEGATIVE COVENANTS

## Section 17.1 Negative Covenants

Until the Obligations have been paid in full, Borrower shall not, and shall not permit any Subsidiary or Affiliate holding any interest in the Property to, without Lender's prior written consent (which, except as expressly provided, may be withheld in Lender's sole and absolute discretion):

(b) create, incur, assume or permit to exist any Lien on the Property, any membership interest in Borrower or any other collateral, other than the Permitted Exceptions and the Liens in favor of Lender and (as to membership interests only, and only as subordinated under the Intercreditor Agreement) the Mezzanine Lender;

(c) sell, transfer, convey, assign, lease (other than leases of residential units and retail space in the ordinary course in accordance with **Section 10.9**), option, or otherwise dispose of the Property or any interest therein, or any membership interest in Borrower, whether directly or indirectly, including by merger, consolidation, division, conversion or otherwise;

(d) change, modify or alter the ownership structure or membership interests of Borrower, or admit any new member, or permit any transfer, pledge, encumbrance or hypothecation of any membership interest, other than the pledge to Lender and the subordinated pledge to the Mezzanine Lender as governed by the Intercreditor Agreement;

(e) amend, restate, modify or waive any provision of Borrower's Articles of Organization or Operating Agreement in any manner that (i) affects the SPE covenants, the Independent Manager provisions, the management structure, the capital contribution obligations, the distribution provisions or the transfer restrictions, or (ii) could reasonably be expected to adversely affect Lender, without Lender's prior written consent;

(f) enter into, amend or consummate any transaction with any Affiliate of Borrower or of any member, including the Mezzanine Lender, except on arm's-length terms and for fair and reasonable consideration, and with prior written notice to Lender;

(g) make any distribution, dividend, return of capital or other payment to any member of Borrower during the Construction Period, except payment of the Developer Fee in accordance with **Section 11.6**; and, during the Mini-Perm Period, make any distribution except from Distributable Cash (as defined in the Operating Agreement) after payment of all debt service, reserves and operating expenses and provided no Default or Event of Default exists;

(h) amend, modify, supplement, terminate, replace or waive any material term of the GMP Contract, the Architect's Agreement or the Plans and Specifications except in accordance with **Article 10**;

(i) amend, modify, supplement or waive any term of the Mezzanine Loan (including the principal amount, interest rate, maturity, amortization, collateral, subordination or remedies), or prepay, defease or refinance the Mezzanine Loan, without Lender's prior written consent;

(j) amend, modify or waive any condition of the NFA Letter, the Soil Management Plan or the Deed Notice, or undertake any activity in the Affected Area inconsistent therewith;

(k) permit any residential occupancy of any portion of the building constructed over or within the Affected Area unless and until Borrower has obtained a written modification of the NFA Letter from NCDEQ expressly permitting such residential use, in form and substance satisfactory to Lender;

(l) change its Fiscal Year, change its method of accounting (except as required by GAAP), or change its name, jurisdiction of organization, organizational identification number or principal place of business without thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Lender and delivery of all filings necessary to maintain the perfection of Lender's Liens;

(m) engage in any business other than the ownership, development, construction, leasing, management and operation of the Project;

(n) make any loan, advance or investment other than (i) investments in cash and cash equivalents, (ii) investments in the Project, and (iii) prepaid expenses in the ordinary course of business;

(o) dissolve, liquidate, merge, consolidate, divide or convert, or file any voluntary petition under the Bankruptcy Code or consent to the appointment of a receiver, or fail to contest in good faith any involuntary petition;

(p) settle or compromise any claim, litigation or arbitration involving an amount in excess of $250,000, or that imposes any non-monetary obligation on Borrower or affects the Property, without Lender's prior written consent;

(q) materially change the use or operation of the Property, or take any action that would cause the Property to violate the CC&Rs, the Zoning Report, any recorded covenant, condition or restriction, or any Environmental Law;

(r) permit the Project to be operated in a manner that would cause the Title Policy to be voided or any of its endorsements to be invalidated;

(s) enter into any easement, license, covenant, condition, restriction, declaration or other agreement affecting title to the Property, or grant any option or right of first refusal with respect to the Property, without Lender's prior written consent;

(t) voluntarily subject the Property to any assessment district, special taxing district, community development district or similar arrangement;

(u) make any capital expenditure not contemplated by the Approved Budget in excess of $250,000 in the aggregate in any Fiscal Year; or

(v) use any portion of the Property in a manner that would cause Lender to be deemed a "lender in possession," "owner or operator" or "arranger" for purposes of CERCLA or any Environmental Law.

## Section 17.2 Permitted Transfers

Notwithstanding **Section 17.1(c)** and **(d)**, the following shall be permitted without Lender's consent, provided that no Default or Event of Default exists and Borrower delivers thirty (30) days' prior written notice (with such documentation as Lender may reasonably require): (a) the pledge of membership interests to the Mezzanine Lender as a second priority lien under the Intercreditor Agreement; and (b) transfers of membership interests resulting from the death of a member to such member's estate or heirs, provided that (i) the transferee executes a joinder to the Pledge Agreement and the Operating Agreement, (ii) the transfer does not result in a change of control, and (iii) no transfer may result in the Borrower having more than ten (10) members or in any member that is not an accredited investor.

# ARTICLE 18 — SINGLE-PURPOSE ENTITY; SEPARATENESS; INDEPENDENT MANAGER

## Section 18.1 SPE Covenants

Borrower shall at all times maintain its status as a single-purpose, bankruptcy-remote entity and shall:

(a) hold no assets other than the Property, the Project and related assets (including cash and cash equivalents and the accounts contemplated by the Loan Documents);

(b) incur no liabilities other than the Permitted Indebtedness, the Loan Documents, and trade payables and accrued expenses incurred in the ordinary course of business;

(c) conduct no business other than the ownership, development, construction, leasing, management and operation of the Project;

(d) maintain its own books, records, financial statements, bank accounts and payroll separate from those of any member, Affiliate or other Person, and not commingle its funds or other assets with those of any member, Affiliate or other Person;

(e) hold itself out as a separate and distinct entity, conduct its business in its own name, and not hold itself out as being liable for the debts of any member or Affiliate or as a division or part of any other Person;

(f) observe all organizational formalities, maintain minutes and records of member and manager actions, and make all required filings with the North Carolina Secretary of State;

(g) pay its own liabilities and expenses from its own funds, and allocate shared overhead and shared expenses (if any) on a basis that is fair and reasonable and that reflects arm's-length dealings;

(h) maintain arm's-length relationships with all Affiliates and enter into no transaction with an Affiliate except on arm's-length terms documented in writing;

(i) not guarantee or become obligated for the debts of any other Person, and not pledge its assets for the benefit of any other Person;

(j) not acquire obligations or securities of any member or Affiliate, and not make any loans to any member or Affiliate;

(k) not identify any member or Affiliate as a division or part of Borrower, and correct any known misunderstanding regarding its separate identity;

(l) maintain adequate capital in light of its contemplated business operations, and cause its members to make the capital contributions required by the Operating Agreement and the Approved Budget;

(m) not commingle any funds held in trust or otherwise for the benefit of third parties;

(n) not engage in any transaction with the Mezzanine Lender except as permitted by the Mezzanine Loan documents and the Intercreditor Agreement; and

(o) file its own tax returns and not file a consolidated return with any member or Affiliate.

## Section 18.2 Independent Manager

(a) **Requirement.** As a condition to Closing, Borrower's Operating Agreement shall be amended to provide, and Borrower shall at all times maintain, at least one manager (the "**Independent Manager**") who (i) is not, and has not been within the preceding five (5) years, an officer, director, manager, employee, member, creditor, supplier, customer, attorney, accountant or Affiliate of Borrower, any member of Borrower, the Mezzanine Lender, Thomas R. Chen or any Affiliate of any of the foregoing; (ii) has no economic interest in Borrower or any such Person; and (iii) is provided by a nationally recognized independent director/manager service provider acceptable to Lender (or is otherwise acceptable to Lender in its reasonable discretion).

(b) **Authority.** The affirmative vote of the Independent Manager shall be required for Borrower to (i) file a voluntary petition under the Bankruptcy Code or consent to the appointment of a receiver, trustee or custodian, (ii) make an assignment for the benefit of creditors, (iii) admit in writing its inability to pay its debts generally as they become due, (iv) dissolve, liquidate, merge, consolidate or transfer all or substantially all of its assets, or (v) amend the provisions of the Operating Agreement relating to the Independent Manager.

(c) **Removal.** The Independent Manager may not be removed, and the provisions of the Operating Agreement relating to the Independent Manager may not be amended, without Lender's prior written consent.

(d) **Springing Obligation.** If at any time Borrower's Operating Agreement does not contain the provisions required by this Section, Borrower shall, within ten (10) Business Days after notice from Lender, cause such provisions to be adopted and an Independent Manager to be appointed.

Chen or any other Affiliate of Borrower in any bankruptcy or insolvency proceeding of Borrower or any such Person. Chen is the managing member of both Brightleaf Investors Group LLC (which holds a 28% membership interest in Borrower) and Brightleaf Mezzanine Capital LLC (the Mezzanine Lender), and that Brightleaf Investors Group LLC received its membership interest in Borrower in consideration of its commitment to arrange the mezzanine financing for the Project rather than for a cash capital contribution. # ARTICLE 19 — ENVIRONMENTAL COVENANTS

## Section 19.1 Compliance with Environmental Laws

Borrower shall, and shall cause all contractors, subcontractors, tenants and occupants to, comply with all Environmental Laws and with all permits, licenses and approvals relating to the environmental condition of the Property. Borrower shall not cause or permit any Release of Hazardous Materials at, on, under or from the Property, and shall not use the Property for any use that would cause Lender to be deemed an "owner or operator" under CERCLA or any similar state law.

## Section 19.2 NFA Letter Compliance

Borrower shall comply with each condition of the NFA Letter and shall, in particular:

(a) **Condition 1 — Vapor Mitigation System.** Cause the Vapor Mitigation System to be designed by a professional engineer licensed in North Carolina, incorporated into the Plans and Specifications, installed beneath any enclosed structure constructed over the Affected Area in accordance with the NCDEQ Division of Waste Management guidelines for vapor intrusion mitigation, and made capable of conversion from passive to active depressurization. Borrower shall deliver as-built drawings and a system performance verification report to NCDEQ within ninety (90) days after completion of the building foundation in the Affected Area, and shall deliver copies of all such submissions and any NCDEQ response to Lender within five (5) Business Days after submission or receipt. Borrower shall maintain the Vapor Mitigation System in good working order for so long as the NFA Letter remains in effect and shall not decommission, modify or impair the system without Lender's prior written consent.

(b) **Condition 2 — Non-Residential Land Use Restriction.** Not construct, use, lease, occupy or permit the occupancy of any residential dwelling unit, or any other "residential use" within the meaning of the NFA Letter, within the Affected Area, unless and until Borrower has obtained from NCDEQ a written modification of the NFA Letter expressly permitting such use, in form and substance satisfactory to Lender, and has delivered a copy thereof to Lender together with an updated appraisal and such other information as Lender may require. Borrower acknowledges that Lender's underwriting and the Appraisal do not reflect the loss of any residential units, and that if the NFA Letter is not modified, Borrower must (i) redesign the Affected Area units (or the affected portion of the building) as non-residential space and deliver revised Plans and Specifications and revised income projections, and (ii) demonstrate to Lender's satisfaction that the Financial Covenants are satisfied on the revised program.

(c) **Condition 3 — Soil Management Plan.** Prior to any excavation, grading or other subsurface disturbance in the Affected Area, prepare and submit to NCDEQ for approval, and obtain NCDEQ's approval of, the Soil Management Plan addressing soil screening, stockpile management, dust control, worker health and safety, personal protective equipment, disposal of impacted soil and confirmation sampling. Borrower shall incorporate the Soil Management Plan into the construction documents, deliver a copy to the Contractor and all relevant subcontractors, provide training to all site personnel, and deliver a copy of the approved Soil Management Plan to Lender.

(d) **Condition 4 — Deed Notice.** Cause the Deed Notice to be prepared, executed and recorded in the Durham County Registry of Deeds in accordance with the NFA Letter, and deliver to Lender a certified copy of the recorded Deed Notice with the recording stamp. Borrower acknowledges that the NFA Letter required the Deed Notice to be recorded within sixty (60) days after September 30, 2024 (i.e., on or before November 29, 2024), that the Phase I ESA dated October 28, 2024 does not reflect that the Deed Notice had been recorded, and that the Deed Notice is not reflected in the Title Commitment. Borrower shall deliver evidence of the recorded Deed Notice not later than five (5) Business Days prior to the Closing Date, or, if not previously recorded, shall cause it to be recorded on the Closing Date concurrently with the recording of the Deed of Trust, and shall deliver to Lender a written statement from NCDEQ or environmental counsel confirming that the late recording does not impair the NFA determination.

## Section 19.3 Environmental Reporting

Borrower shall deliver to Lender (a) copies of all submissions to and correspondence with NCDEQ relating to the Property, within five (5) Business Days after submission or receipt; (b) evidence of the annual inspection and certification of the Vapor Mitigation System within thirty (30) days after completion; (c) copies of all indoor air quality or sub-slab soil gas monitoring results, within ten (10) days after receipt; and (d) an annual environmental compliance certificate, signed by the Managing Member, certifying compliance with this Article and the NFA Letter.

## Section 19.4 No Further Remediation; Additional Investigation

If any Governmental Authority requires additional investigation, remediation, monitoring or reporting with respect to the Property, or if Lender reasonably determines that any Hazardous Materials condition at the Property requires investigation or remediation, Borrower shall, at its sole cost, promptly undertake and diligently complete such work in accordance with applicable Environmental Laws and shall keep Lender fully informed. Borrower shall not enter into any consent decree, administrative order or settlement relating to the environmental condition of the Property without Lender's prior written consent.

## Section 19.5 Notice of Releases

Borrower shall notify Lender in writing within twenty-four (24) hours after Borrower obtains knowledge of (a) any Release or threatened Release of Hazardous Materials at, on, under or from the Property that requires reporting under any Environmental Law, (b) any inspection, investigation, notice of violation, order or information request from any Governmental Authority relating to the environmental condition of the Property, or (c) any claim by any third party relating to Hazardous Materials or Environmental Laws.

## Section 19.6 Lender's Environmental Rights

Lender may, at Borrower's expense (but not more than once per year in the absence of an Event of Default or a reasonable basis for concern), obtain a Phase I ESA update or other environmental assessment of the Property. Borrower shall cooperate with any such assessment and shall provide access to the Property and to all environmental records. Borrower shall not communicate with NCDEQ regarding the NFA Letter, the Affected Area or the Vapor Mitigation System without prior notice to Lender (except in an emergency), and shall permit Lender's counsel to participate in any such communications.

## Section 19.7 Environmental Indemnity; Survival

The Environmental Indemnity shall be in addition to, and not in limitation of, the covenants in this Article, and shall survive repayment of the Loan and any transfer of the Property by foreclosure, deed in lieu of foreclosure or otherwise. The obligations of Borrower and the Guarantors under this Article and the Environmental Indemnity shall not be limited by any exculpatory or nonrecourse provision of any Loan Document.

## Section 19.8 Pollution Legal Liability Insurance

Lender may require, and Borrower shall obtain within sixty (60) days after Lender's written request, a pollution legal liability insurance policy (or environmental remediation insurance) with coverage, limits, deductible, term and insurer rating reasonably satisfactory to Lender, naming Lender as additional insured and loss payee, and shall collaterally assign such policy to Lender. Lender's failure to require such insurance at Closing shall not constitute a waiver of its right to require it thereafter.

## Section 19.9 Environmental Default

Any failure to comply with this Article, the NFA Letter, the Soil Management Plan or the Deed Notice shall constitute an Event of Default under **Section 24.13** and a Recourse Trigger under **Section 13.4(e)**.

## Section 19.10 Lender Not an Operator

Nothing in this Agreement, and no inspection, approval, consent or advance by Lender, shall be deemed to make Lender an "owner or operator," "arranger," "transporter" or "participant in management" of the Property or the Project for purposes of CERCLA, any Environmental Law or any other law. Borrower shall include in all leases and construction contracts such provisions as are reasonably necessary to preserve Lender's secured creditor exemption.

## Section 22.2 Lien Subordination of Membership Interests Pledge

The Intercreditor Agreement shall provide that Lender's security interest in one hundred percent (100%) of the membership interests in Borrower is a first priority perfected security interest, and that the Mezzanine Lender's security interest in the same collateral is a second priority security interest, in each case pursuant to an intercreditor and subordination agreement, UCC-8 filings, and control arrangements satisfactory to Lender.

## Section 22.3 Standstill Period

## Section 22.5 Purchase Option

The Intercreditor Agreement shall grant the Mezzanine Lender an option, exercisable at any time after the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, to purchase the Loan from Lender at a purchase price equal to the outstanding principal balance plus all accrued and unpaid interest, fees, costs, expenses and premiums.

## Section 22.6 No Amendment Without Lender Consent

The Intercreditor Agreement shall prohibit the Mezzanine Lender and Borrower from amending, modifying, supplementing or waiving any material term of the Mezzanine Loan (including the principal amount, interest rate, payment terms, maturity, collateral, amortization, subordination or remedies) without Lender's prior written consent, and shall prohibit any increase in the principal amount of the Mezzanine Loan other than the accrual of paid-in-kind interest and capitalized fees expressly permitted by the Intercreditor Agreement.

## Section 22.7 Bankruptcy Restrictions

The Intercreditor Agreement shall prohibit the Mezzanine Lender (and any Affiliate of the Mezzanine Lender) from filing or joining in the filing of any involuntary petition under the Bankruptcy Code against Borrower, from proposing or supporting a plan of reorganization that does not provide for the indefeasible payment in full in cash of the Obligations, and from objecting to or contesting any motion by Lender for relief from the automatic stay or for the appointment of a receiver.

## Section 22.8 No Contest of Remedies

The Intercreditor Agreement shall provide that the Mezzanine Lender will not contest, challenge, delay or interfere with Lender's exercise of remedies under the Loan Documents, including any foreclosure of the Deed of Trust or any exercise of rights with respect to the membership interests.

## Section 22.9 Affiliate Acknowledgments

The Intercreditor Agreement shall include express acknowledgments by the Mezzanine Lender that (a) Thomas R. Chen controls both the Mezzanine Lender and Brightleaf Investors Group LLC (a 28% member of Borrower), (b) the Mezzanine Lender has no rights against Lender arising from such relationship, (c) the Mezzanine Lender is not a third-party beneficiary of any Loan Document, and (d) the Mezzanine Lender will not use its affiliate relationship with Brightleaf Investors Group LLC to influence Borrower's decisions in a manner adverse to Lender, including through the exercise of Brightleaf Investors Group LLC's approval rights under Section 3.2 of the Operating Agreement.

## Section 22.10 Mezzanine Default

Any default under the Mezzanine Loan or the Intercreditor Agreement shall constitute an Event of Default under **Section 24.4**. Borrower shall deliver to Lender copies of all notices of default and other material notices delivered or received under the Mezzanine Loan within three (3) Business Days after delivery or receipt.

## Section 22.11 Lender's Right to Cure

Lender may, but shall not be obligated to, cure any default under the Mezzanine Loan on Borrower's behalf if Lender determines that such cure is necessary to protect its interest in the collateral. Amounts so advanced shall constitute Obligations secured by the Loan Documents and shall bear interest at the Default Rate.

## Section 22.12 Mezzanine Interest and Combined Coverage

Borrower acknowledges that (a) the Mezzanine Loan bears interest at a fixed rate of 12.50% per annum, (b) interest on the Mezzanine Loan is to be paid-in-kind during the Construction Period and in cash during the Mini-Perm Period, (c) the accrual of paid-in-kind interest will increase the Mezzanine Loan balance to approximately $12,075,000 (simple interest) or $12,554,600 (monthly compounding) by the Construction Maturity Date, and (d) neither the debt service on the Mezzanine Loan nor such accrual is funded by any source identified in the Approved Budget. Borrower shall deliver to Lender, prior to the commencement of the Mini-Perm Period, evidence reasonably satisfactory to Lender that the Mezzanine Loan will be serviced in cash, repaid, or restructured so that the Combined DSCR covenant in **Section 16.4** is satisfied.

## Section 22.13 Payments to Mezzanine Lender During Default

During the continuance of an Event of Default, Borrower shall not make, and the Mezzanine Lender shall not accept, any payment of principal, interest, fees or other amounts on the Mezzanine Loan (other than payments of regularly scheduled interest not in excess of the amount permitted by the Intercreditor Agreement), and any such payment shall be held in trust for Lender and promptly remitted to Lender.

# ARTICLE 23 — REPORTING REQUIREMENTS

## Section 23.1 Monthly Construction Reports

During the Construction Period, Borrower shall deliver to Lender, within fifteen (15) days after the end of each calendar month, a construction progress report in form satisfactory to Lender, including (a) a comparison of actual to scheduled progress, (b) a certified statement of the percentage of completion and the value of work in place, (c) a budget reconciliation, (d) a log of all change orders (approved and pending) and all claims, (e) the Contractor's and Architect's certifications, (f) the construction inspector's report, (g) the Interest Reserve reconciliation required by **Section 8.5**, and (h) a statement of Equity Contributions applied to date.

## Section 23.2 Quarterly Financial Statements

Borrower shall deliver to Lender, within forty-five (45) days after the end of each Fiscal Quarter, unaudited financial statements of Borrower (balance sheet, income statement and statement of cash flows, with a comparison to the Approved Budget), a Rent Roll (if any leases are in place), a leasing status report, a schedule of accounts payable aged sixty (60) days or more, and a certification of compliance with the Financial Covenants.

## Section 23.3 Annual Financial Statements

Borrower shall deliver to Lender, within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of each Fiscal Year, (a) audited financial statements of Borrower prepared by a nationally or regionally recognized independent certified public accounting firm acceptable to Lender, (b) the annual net worth certification required by **Section 16.5**, and (c) the compliance certificate required by **Section 16.8**.

## Section 23.4 Guarantor Reporting

Borrower shall cause each Guarantor to deliver the financial statements, liquidity certifications and tax returns required by **Section 13.9**.

## Section 23.5 Quarterly Guarantor Liquidity Certifications

Borrower shall deliver to Lender, within forty-five (45) days after the end of each Fiscal Quarter, a certification of the combined Liquid Assets of the Guarantors, in form satisfactory to Lender, together with supporting statements from each Guarantor's financial institutions (or such other evidence as Lender may reasonably require).

## Section 23.6 Notices

Borrower shall deliver the notices required by **Section 15.1(i)** within the time periods specified therein (and in any event within five (5) Business Days after Borrower obtains knowledge of the applicable event).

## Section 23.7 Other Information; Audit Rights

Borrower shall deliver to Lender such other information, certificates, budgets, leases, contracts and reports as Lender may reasonably request, and shall permit Lender and its representatives to audit and copy Borrower's books and records relating to the Property, the Project and the Loan at any time during normal business hours upon reasonable notice.

## Section 23.8 Know Your Customer

Borrower shall deliver to Lender such information and documentation as Lender may reasonably request to comply with its customer identification, beneficial ownership and anti-money-laundering requirements, and shall promptly notify Lender of any change in the identity of its beneficial owners.

# ARTICLE 24 — EVENTS OF DEFAULT

## Section 24.1 Monetary Default

Borrower fails to pay any principal, interest, fee or other amount due under any Loan Document when due, and such failure continues for five (5) days after the due date; *provided* that no grace period shall apply to (a) the payment due on the Maturity Date, (b) any payment required under **Section 2.4**, **Section 8.3(b)**, **Section 16.3(b)** or **Section 16.4(b)**, or (c) any payment due after acceleration.

## Section 24.2 Representation Default

Any representation or warranty made by Borrower or any Guarantor in any Loan Document, or in any certificate, report, financial statement or other document furnished in connection therewith, proves to have been untrue, incorrect or misleading in any material respect when made or deemed made.

## Section 24.3 Covenant Default

Borrower or any Guarantor fails to observe or perform any covenant, condition or agreement contained in any Loan Document (other than a covenant for which a specific remedy is provided in **Article 16** or elsewhere, or a covenant described in **Sections 24.1** through **24.2** and **24.4** through **24.19**), and such failure continues for thirty (30) days after the earlier of (a) written notice from Lender and (b) the date on which Borrower obtains knowledge of such failure; *provided* that if such failure is capable of cure but cannot reasonably be cured within such thirty (30) day period, and Borrower is diligently and continuously pursuing cure, such period shall be extended for an additional thirty (30) days (but in no event beyond the Maturity Date). The extension in the preceding sentence shall not apply to any failure to maintain insurance, to any failure to deliver a required payment, to any breach of **Article 17** or **Article 18**, or to any failure to satisfy a Financial Covenant (as to which **Article 16** provides the exclusive cure).

## Section 24.4 Cross-Default

(a) A default or event of default occurs under the Mezzanine Loan, the Intercreditor Agreement or the mezzanine pledge documents, or (b) Borrower or any Guarantor defaults (beyond any applicable notice and cure period) under any other Indebtedness or material agreement involving an obligation in excess of $500,000, including the GMP Contract, the Architect's Agreement or the CC&Rs.

## Section 24.5 Bankruptcy and Insolvency

Borrower, any Guarantor, any member of Borrower, the Mezzanine Lender, Brightleaf Investors Group LLC or any Affiliate of any of the foregoing (a) commences any case, proceeding or other action under any bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, liquidation, dissolution or similar law, (b) consents to the institution of, or fails to contest in good faith within sixty (60) days, any such proceeding, (c) applies for or consents to the appointment of a receiver, trustee, custodian, conservator, liquidator or similar official, (d) makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors, (e) admits in writing its inability to pay its debts generally as they become due, or (f) suffers the entry of an order for relief or the appointment of a receiver, trustee or custodian that is not dismissed within sixty (60) days.

## Section 24.6 Judgments

One or more judgments, orders or decrees for the payment of money in an aggregate amount exceeding $500,000 (not covered by insurance as to which the insurer has acknowledged coverage in writing) is entered against Borrower, any Guarantor or the Property, and remains unsatisfied, unbonded or unstayed for thirty (30) days, or any such judgment is enforced against the Property.

## Section 24.7 Liens; Attachment

Any claim of lien, levy, attachment, execution, sequestration or other process is issued or filed against the Property, the Project or any other collateral and is not released, bonded off or stayed within thirty (30) days, or any Lien other than a Permitted Exception or a Lien in favor of Lender attaches to the Property.

## Section 24.8 Material Adverse Change

A material adverse change occurs in the financial condition, business, operations, properties or prospects of Borrower, any Guarantor, the Project or the Property, or in the value of the collateral, as determined by Lender in its reasonable discretion, including any material decline in the as-completed or as-stabilized value of the Property, any material increase in Total Project Costs not funded as required by this Agreement, or any material impairment of the enforceability of the Loan Documents.

## Section 24.9 Construction Delay Default

The Project is more than ninety (90) days behind the Baseline Schedule (as adjusted for Approved Change Orders and Unavoidable Delays) at any time during the Construction Period, or Borrower fails to achieve Substantial Completion on or before the Outside Completion Date (a "**Construction Delay Default**").

## Section 24.10 Abandonment; Suspension

Borrower or the Contractor suspends or abandons construction of the Project for more than fifteen (15) consecutive days (other than as permitted by **Section 10.1**), or Borrower fails to cause construction to commence within thirty (30) days after Closing.

## Section 24.11 Insurance

Borrower fails to maintain any insurance required by **Article 20** in full force and effect for more than ten (10) days after the earlier of notice from Lender and the date on which Borrower obtains knowledge of such failure.

## Section 24.12 SPE Covenants; Independent Manager

Borrower breaches any covenant in **Article 18**, or the Operating Agreement is amended in any manner that eliminates, weakens or renders ineffective the SPE covenants or the Independent Manager provisions.

## Section 24.13 Environmental Default

(a) Borrower fails to comply with any condition of the NFA Letter, the Soil Management Plan or the Deed Notice; (b) any violation of any Environmental Law occurs with respect to the Property that requires reporting, investigation, remediation or payment of a penalty in excess of $100,000; (c) any Governmental Authority issues any order, directive, notice of violation or administrative complaint relating to Hazardous Materials at the Property; (d) any lien arises under any Environmental Law; or (e) any Release of Hazardous Materials occurs at the Property that is not promptly remediated in accordance with Environmental Laws.

## Section 24.14 Guaranty Default; Guarantor Events

(a) Any Guarantor repudiates, revokes, terminates, disaffirms or challenges the validity or enforceability of any Guaranty, or fails to perform any obligation thereunder; (b) any Guarantor dies, becomes incapacitated, or becomes the subject of any Insolvency Event; (c) any Guarantor fails to satisfy any covenant in **Section 13.8** and does not cure within the period permitted by **Section 13.8(d)**; or (d) any Guarantor is convicted of, or pleads guilty or nolo contendere to, a felony or any crime involving fraud or dishonesty.

## Section 24.15 Failure to Complete

Final Completion has not occurred on or before the date that is one hundred eighty (180) days after the Outside Completion Date.

## Section 24.16 Interest Reserve; Equity

(a) Borrower fails to fund an Interest Reserve Shortfall within the period required by **Section 8.3(b)**; (b) Borrower fails to fund the Required Equity Contribution or any additional Equity Contribution required by **Section 2.4**; or (c) Borrower fails to satisfy the conditions to conversion to the Mini-Perm Period on or before the Construction Maturity Date.

## Section 24.17 Prohibited Transfer; Change of Control

Any sale, transfer, encumbrance or other disposition of the Property or any membership interest in Borrower occurs in violation of this Agreement, or any change of control of Borrower occurs (including by reason of the exercise of remedies by the Mezzanine Lender).

## Section 24.18 Title; Permits; CC&Rs

The Title Policy is not issued at Closing, any title defect or unpermitted encumbrance arises, any required permit, approval, certificate of occupancy or architectural review approval is revoked, suspended or expires and is not reinstated within thirty (30) days, or the Property becomes non-conforming under the CC&Rs or applicable zoning.

## Section 24.19 Notice and Cure; No Implied Waiver

Lender shall not be required to give notice of any Event of Default except to the extent expressly provided in this Article. Any notice given with respect to one Default or Event of Default shall not constitute a waiver or cure of any other Default or Event of Default. The acceptance by Lender of any payment after the occurrence of an Event of Default shall not constitute a waiver of such Event of Default or of any other Event of Default.

# ARTICLE 25 — REMEDIES

## Section 25.1 Acceleration

Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, Lender may, at its option and without further notice to Borrower (except as required by applicable law), declare the entire outstanding principal balance of the Loan, together with all accrued and unpaid interest, fees, costs, expenses and other Obligations, immediately due and payable, whereupon the same shall become immediately due and payable. Upon the occurrence of an Event of Default described in **Section 24.5**, all amounts shall become automatically due and payable without notice or demand of any kind.

## Section 25.2 Suspension of Advances

Upon the occurrence of a Default or an Event of Default, Lender may cease making any further Advances, including any Advance previously approved, and may withhold the release of any Retainage.

## Section 25.3 Default Rate

Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, all outstanding amounts shall bear interest at the Default Rate as provided in **Section 3.4**.

## Section 25.4 Foreclosure and Other Real Property Remedies

Lender may foreclose the Deed of Trust in accordance with the power of sale contained therein and applicable North Carolina law, including N.C.G.S. Chapter 45, Article 2A, or may proceed by judicial foreclosure, and may exercise any and all other rights and remedies available to a mortgagee under North Carolina law, including the right to seek the appointment of a receiver under N.C.G.S. §1-501 *et seq.*, to obtain possession of the Property, to collect rents (whether by assignment of rents, pendente lite receivership or otherwise), and to apply for a deficiency judgment in accordance with N.C.G.S. §45-21.36.

## Section 25.5 UCC Remedies

Lender may exercise all rights and remedies of a secured party under Article 9 of the UCC and other applicable law with respect to the personal property collateral and the pledged membership interests, including (a) the right to file UCC-1 and UCC-8 financing statements, (b) the right to notify account debtors and obligors to make payment directly to Lender, (c) the right to sell, assign, transfer or otherwise dispose of the membership interests at public or private sale (and Lender may be the purchaser at any such sale to the extent permitted by law), (d) the right to exercise the irrevocable proxies granted under **Section 12.2** and to vote the membership interests, and (e) the right to exercise all rights of the pledgor of the membership interests.

## Section 25.6 Guaranty Remedies

Lender may proceed directly against any Guarantor under any Guaranty, whether or not Lender has proceeded against Borrower or the collateral and whether or not the collateral has been exhausted.

## Section 25.7 Application of Proceeds

All amounts realized from the exercise of remedies shall be applied as provided in **Section 4.5**, and any surplus shall be paid to Borrower or as otherwise required by applicable law.

## Section 25.8 No Marshaling; Waiver of Defenses

Borrower and each Guarantor waive any right to require Lender to marshal assets, to exhaust any remedy or to proceed against any Person or any collateral in any particular order, and waive all rights of redemption and reinstatement to the fullest extent permitted by law (except any non-waivable statutory right of redemption, which Borrower acknowledges is limited under North Carolina law).

## Section 25.9 Cumulative Remedies

All rights and remedies of Lender under the Loan Documents are cumulative and not exclusive of any rights or remedies provided by law or in equity. No delay or failure by Lender in exercising any right or remedy shall operate as a waiver thereof, and no single or partial exercise of any right or remedy shall preclude any other or further exercise thereof.

## Section 25.10 Lender's Right to Perform

Lender may perform any obligation of Borrower under the Loan Documents upon Borrower's failure to do so, and the costs thereof shall be Obligations secured by the Loan Documents. Lender shall give Borrower such notice as is reasonable under the circumstances prior to performing, except in an emergency.

## Section 25.11 Attorney's Fees

If any Loan Document is placed in the hands of an attorney for collection or enforcement, or if any suit or proceeding is brought to enforce or interpret any Loan Document, Borrower shall pay Lender's reasonable attorneys' fees and costs in addition to all other amounts due, as permitted by N.C.G.S. §6-21.2 (in the amount provided therein) or, if such statute does not apply, in the amount of fifteen percent (15%) of the outstanding principal and interest then due, to the extent permitted by applicable law.

## Section 25.12 No Waiver by Acceptance

No acceptance by Lender of any partial payment or any payment after the Maturity Date shall constitute a waiver of any Event of Default or of Lender's right to exercise any remedy.

Upon the occurrence of any Event of Default described in **Section 24.5**, Lender may file and prove a claim for the whole amount of the Obligations and may file such other documents and take such other actions as Lender deems necessary or advisable to protect its interests, and each of Borrower and the Guarantors irrevocably authorizes Lender to do so.

## Section 29.18 Replacement of Disbursement Agent

Lender may replace the Disbursement Agent at any time (at Borrower's expense) if Lender reasonably determines that the Disbursement Agent is unable or unwilling to perform its obligations, has become insolvent, or has failed to deliver a required endorsement or disbursement. Borrower shall cooperate in any such replacement.

# ARTICLE 30 — GUARANTOR JOINDER

## Section 30.1 Limited Joinder of Guarantors

Each Guarantor joins in this Agreement for the limited purposes of (a) **Article 13** (Guaranties), (b) **Article 14** (as to itself), (c) **Article 16** (as to the covenants in **Sections 16.6** and **16.7**), (d) **Article 17** (as applicable to such Guarantor), (e) **Article 24**, (f) **Article 25**, (g) **Article 26**, (h) **Article 29**, and (i) the representations, warranties, covenants and agreements applicable to such Guarantor under the Guaranties. Each Guarantor acknowledges receipt of a copy of this Agreement and the other Loan Documents, and agrees to be bound by the provisions referred to in this Section.

## Section 30.2 Guarantor Acknowledgments

Each Guarantor acknowledges that (a) such Guarantor has read and understands the Loan Documents, (b) such Guarantor has had the opportunity to consult with independent counsel, (c) the Obligations are substantial and such Guarantor's obligations under the Guaranties are not disproportionate to the benefits such Guarantor receives as a member of Borrower and an owner of the Project, (d) such Guarantor has received or expects to receive substantial direct and indirect economic benefit from the Loan, and (e) such Guarantor's obligations under the Guaranties are supported by adequate consideration.

## Section 30.3 Joint and Several Liability

The obligations of the Guarantors under the Guaranties and this Agreement are joint and several, except that the Partial Repayment Guaranty is subject to the aggregate limitation on recovery set forth in **Section 13.3**.

# ARTICLE 20 — INSURANCE

## Section 20.1 Required Insurance

Borrower shall procure and maintain, at its sole cost and expense, from insurers licensed in North Carolina and having an A.M. Best rating of not less than A- VIII (or such other rating as Lender may approve), the following insurance:

(a) **Builder's Risk.** All-risk builder's risk insurance (including soft cost, materials in transit, materials stored off-site, flood, windstorm, earth movement and equipment breakdown coverages) on a completed value, replacement cost basis in an amount not less than the hard construction costs of $34,750,000, naming Lender as mortgagee and loss payee as its interests may appear, with a deductible not exceeding $50,000 and with no coinsurance penalty;

(b) **Commercial General Liability.** Coverage on an occurrence basis with limits of not less than $5,000,000 per occurrence and $10,000,000 in the aggregate, including premises-operations, products/completed operations, contractual liability (including the insured contract covering the Loan Documents), personal and advertising injury, and, during construction, construction defect and explosion, collapse and underground coverages, naming Lender as additional insured on a primary and non-contributory basis;

(c) **Umbrella/Excess Liability.** Coverage of not less than $10,000,000 per occurrence and in the aggregate, in excess of the commercial general liability, automobile liability and employer's liability coverages, naming Lender as additional insured;

(d) **Workers' Compensation and Employer's Liability.** Statutory workers' compensation coverage as required by N.C.G.S. Chapter 97 and employer's liability coverage of not less than $1,000,000 each accident, each disease and policy limit;

(e) **Automobile Liability.** Coverage of not less than $1,000,000 combined single limit for owned, hired and non-owned vehicles;

(f) **Flood Insurance.** If any portion of the Property is located in a Special Flood Hazard Area (as determined by a Standard Flood Hazard Determination Form obtained by Lender prior to Closing), flood insurance in an amount not less than the lesser of the outstanding principal balance of the Loan or the maximum amount available under the National Flood Insurance Program, plus excess flood coverage in an amount reasonably required by Lender. Borrower acknowledges that the Appraisal identifies the Property as located in Zone X (FIRM Panel 3710406400J, effective May 2, 2019) and that the Phase I ESA identifies the Property as located in Zone X (FIRM Panel 3720098700J, effective March 2, 2009); Lender shall obtain a current flood determination and the results thereof shall control;

(g) **Professional Liability.** Borrower shall cause the Architect to maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than $2,000,000 per claim, and shall cause the Contractor to maintain contractor's pollution liability insurance (or an equivalent endorsement) covering work in the Affected Area in an amount not less than $5,000,000, in each case naming Lender as additional insured and providing for thirty (30) days' notice of cancellation; and

(h) **Other Insurance.** Such other insurance (including ordinance or law, terrorism, boiler and machinery, and equipment breakdown coverage) as Lender may reasonably require.

## Section 20.2 Policy Requirements

All policies shall (a) name Lender as mortgagee and/or additional insured, as applicable, (b) provide that no cancellation, non-renewal, reduction in coverage or material modification shall be effective without thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Lender (ten (10) days for non-payment of premium), (c) be primary and non-contributory with respect to Lender's own insurance, (d) waive subrogation against Lender, and (e) with respect to builder's risk, include a standard mortgage clause. Borrower shall deliver certificates of insurance (ACORD 28 or equivalent) and, upon request, certified copies of the policies, prior to Closing and at each renewal.

## Section 20.3 Evidence and Renewal

Borrower shall deliver evidence of renewal not less than ten (10) days prior to the expiration of each policy. If Borrower fails to maintain any required insurance, Lender may (but shall not be obligated to) obtain such insurance at Borrower's expense, and the amount so expended shall be a protective advance under **Section 9.10**.

## Section 20.4 Contractor's Insurance

Borrower shall cause the Contractor and all subcontractors to maintain insurance meeting the requirements of the GMP Contract and this Article, with Lender named as additional insured, and shall cause the Contractor to deliver to Lender copies of its policies, endorsements and certificates, together with evidence of the payment and performance bonds required by **Section 10.4(b)**.

## Section 20.5 No Occupancy Without Insurance

Borrower shall not permit any use or occupancy of the Property that would void or suspend any required insurance coverage, and shall not permit any policy to lapse.

## Section 20.6 Casualty and Restoration

Borrower shall promptly notify Lender of any Casualty. Lender shall make insurance proceeds available for restoration of the Property only if (a) no Default or Event of Default exists, (b) Lender determines that the Property can be restored to its pre-Casualty condition and value within the earlier of the Outside Completion Date and the Maturity Date, (c) the cost of restoration does not exceed the available insurance proceeds plus other funds committed by Borrower, (d) the restoration is economically feasible in Lender's reasonable judgment, and (e) Borrower deposits the deductible and any shortfall with Lender. If such conditions are not satisfied, Lender may apply the proceeds to the Obligations in accordance with **Section 7.2(a)**. Borrowers' obligations under this Section shall be secured by the Deed of Trust and, if Lender elects not to make proceeds available, Borrower shall nevertheless be obligated at its option to restore or to permit Lender to apply proceeds.

## Section 20.7 Condemnation

If all or any material portion of the Property is taken by eminent domain or conveyed in lieu thereof, Lender may, at its election, apply the award to the Obligations in accordance with **Section 7.2(a)** or make the award available for restoration on the conditions set forth in **Section 20.6**.

# ARTICLE 21 — TITLE AND SURVEY

## Section 21.1 Title Insurance

Borrower shall cause the Title Policy to be issued at Closing in accordance with **Section 12.3**, and shall pay all premiums, endorsement charges and recording fees. Borrower shall cause the Title Policy to be dated as of the Closing Date (or to include a gap endorsement) and to insure the Deed of Trust in the full amount of the Commitment, without any exception for the Prior Deed of Trust, any mechanics' or materialmen's lien arising from pre-Closing work, any environmental land use restriction (other than as approved by Lender) or any other monetary lien.

## Section 21.2 Title Date-Downs

Borrower shall cause the Disbursement Agent to deliver to Lender, with each Draw Request and at such other times as Lender may require, a date-down endorsement to the Title Policy confirming that no intervening lien, encumbrance or title defect has been recorded since the effective date of the prior endorsement. Borrower shall pay all costs of such endorsements.

## Section 21.3 Survey

Borrower shall deliver the ALTA/NSPS Survey required by **Section 12.5** prior to Closing, and thereafter shall deliver an updated survey upon Substantial Completion and at such other times as Lender may reasonably require. The Survey shall be sufficient to permit the deletion of the standard survey exceptions from the Title Policy and to obtain the survey, contiguity, access and location endorsements required by **Section 12.3**.

## Section 21.4 Legal Description

The legal description of the Property set forth in **Exhibit A** has been derived from the Title Commitment. Prior to Closing, Borrower shall deliver to Lender (a) the ALTA/NSPS Survey and (b) the Disbursement Agent's written confirmation that the legal description in **Exhibit A** conforms to the Survey, the Title Commitment and the deed records of Durham County, including the metes and bounds descriptions of Parcel 0821-04-72-3341 and Parcel 0821-04-72-4102. Borrower acknowledges that (i) the Title Commitment describes Parcel 0821-04-72-3341 as containing approximately 2.09 acres and Parcel 0821-04-72-4102 as containing approximately 1.38 acres (approximately 3.47 acres in the aggregate), (ii) the Phase I ESA describes the parcels as containing approximately 1.89 acres and 1.58 acres, respectively, and (iii) the Appraisal describes approximately 420 feet of frontage along Foster Street, whereas the Title Commitment's metes and bounds descriptions reflect 298.62 feet and 201.88 feet of frontage (500.50 feet combined). The ALTA/NSPS Survey shall resolve these discrepancies, and **Exhibit A** shall be conformed accordingly prior to the recording of the Deed of Trust.

## Section 21.5 No Further Encumbrances

Borrower shall not grant, permit or suffer any easement, covenant, condition, restriction, license, option or other encumbrance affecting the Property (other than the Permitted Exceptions) without Lender's prior written consent.

# ARTICLE 22 — MEZZANINE LOAN; INTERCREDITOR AGREEMENT

## Section 22.1 Intercreditor Agreement Required

As a condition to Closing, Lender, Borrower and the Mezzanine Lender shall have executed and delivered the Intercreditor Agreement in form and substance satisfactory to Lender and its counsel. The Intercreditor Agreement shall at a minimum provide for each of the matters described in this Article. Borrower's failure to deliver a fully executed Intercreditor Agreement at Closing shall entitle Lender to decline to close, and no Advance shall be made until it is delivered.

## Section 22.2 Lien Subordination of Membership Interests Pledge

The Intercreditor Agreement shall provide that Lender's security interest in one hundred percent (100%) of the membership interests in Borrower is a first priority perfected security interest, and that the Mezzanine Lender's security interest in the same collateral is a second priority security interest, in each case pursuant to an intercreditor and subordination agreement, UCC-8 filings, and control arrangements satisfactory to Lender.

## Section 22.3 Standstill Period

The Intercreditor Agreement shall provide that, following the occurrence of a default under the Mezzanine Loan, the Mezzanine Lender may not exercise any right or remedy (whether against Borrower, the membership interests, the Property or the Mezzanine collateral) for a period of not less than ninety (90) days, and thereafter only if the senior Obligations remain outstanding and Lender has not commenced and is not diligently pursuing remedies.

## Section 22.4 Notice and Cure Rights

The Intercreditor Agreement shall provide that the Mezzanine Lender is entitled to receive copies of all notices of default delivered by Lender to Borrower and to cure any default under the Loan within the cure periods available to Borrower plus an additional thirty (30) days (or such longer period as is customary), and that Lender will not foreclose on the membership interests without prior written notice to the Mezzanine Lender.

## Section 22.5 Purchase Option

The Intercreditor Agreement shall grant the Mezzanine Lender an option, exercisable at any time after the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, to purchase the Loan from Lender at a purchase price equal to the outstanding principal balance plus all accrued and unpaid interest, fees, costs, expenses and premiums.

## Section 22.6 No Amendment Without Lender Consent

The Intercreditor Agreement shall prohibit the Mezzanine Lender and Borrower from amending, modifying, supplementing or waiving any material term of the Mezzanine Loan (including the principal amount, interest rate, payment terms, maturity, collateral, amortization, subordination or remedies) without Lender's prior written consent, and shall prohibit any increase in the principal amount of the Mezzanine Loan other than the accrual of paid-in-kind interest and capitalized fees expressly permitted by the Intercreditor Agreement.

## Section 22.7 Bankruptcy Restrictions

The Intercreditor Agreement shall prohibit the Mezzanine Lender (and any Affiliate of the Mezzanine Lender) from filing or joining in the filing of any involuntary petition under the Bankruptcy Code against Borrower, from proposing or supporting a plan of reorganization that does not provide for the indefeasible payment in full in cash of the Obligations, and from objecting to or contesting any motion by Lender for relief from the automatic stay or for the appointment of a receiver.

## Section 22.8 No Contest of Remedies

The Intercreditor Agreement shall provide that the Mezzanine Lender will not contest, challenge, delay or interfere with Lender's exercise of remedies under the Loan Documents, including any foreclosure of the Deed of Trust or any exercise of rights with respect to the membership interests.

## Section 22.9 Affiliate Acknowledgments

The Intercreditor Agreement shall include express acknowledgments by the Mezzanine Lender that (a) Thomas R. Chen controls both the Mezzanine Lender and Brightleaf Investors Group LLC (a 28% member of Borrower), (b) the Mezzanine Lender has no rights against Lender arising from such relationship, (c) the Mezzanine Lender is not a third-party beneficiary of any Loan Document, and (d) the Mezzanine Lender will not use its affiliate relationship with Brightleaf Investors Group LLC to influence Borrower's decisions in a manner adverse to Lender, including through the exercise of Brightleaf Investors Group LLC's approval rights under Section 3.2 of the Operating Agreement.

## Section 22.10 Mezzanine Default

Any default under the Mezzanine Loan or the Intercreditor Agreement shall constitute an Event of Default under **Section 24.4**. Borrower shall deliver to Lender copies of all notices of default and other material notices delivered or received under the Mezzanine Loan within three (3) Business Days after delivery or receipt.

## Section 22.11 Lender's Right to Cure

Lender may, but shall not be obligated to, cure any default under the Mezzanine Loan on Borrower's behalf if Lender determines that such cure is necessary to protect its interest in the collateral. Amounts so advanced shall constitute Obligations secured by the Loan Documents and shall bear interest at the Default Rate.

## Section 22.12 Mezzanine Interest and Combined Coverage

Borrower acknowledges that (a) the Mezzanine Loan bears interest at a fixed rate of 12.50% per annum, (b) interest on the Mezzanine Loan is to be paid-in-kind during the Construction Period and in cash during the Mini-Perm Period, (c) the accrual of paid-in-kind interest will increase the Mezzanine Loan balance to approximately $12,075,000 (simple interest) or $12,554,600 (monthly compounding) by the Construction Maturity Date, and (d) neither the debt service on the Mezzanine Loan nor such accrual is funded by any source identified in the Approved Budget. Borrower shall deliver to Lender, prior to the commencement of the Mini-Perm Period, evidence reasonably satisfactory to Lender that the Mezzanine Loan will be serviced in cash, repaid, or restructured so that the Combined DSCR covenant in **Section 16.4** is satisfied.

## Section 22.13 Payments to Mezzanine Lender During Default

During the continuance of an Event of Default, Borrower shall not make, and the Mezzanine Lender shall not accept, any payment of principal, interest, fees or other amounts on the Mezzanine Loan (other than payments of regularly scheduled interest not in excess of the amount permitted by the Intercreditor Agreement), and any such payment shall be held in trust for Lender and promptly remitted to Lender.

# ARTICLE 23 — REPORTING REQUIREMENTS

## Section 23.1 Monthly Construction Reports

During the Construction Period, Borrower shall deliver to Lender, within fifteen (15) days after the end of each calendar month, a construction progress report in form satisfactory to Lender, including (a) a comparison of actual to scheduled progress, (b) a certified statement of the percentage of completion and the value of work in place, (c) a budget reconciliation, (d) a log of all change orders (approved and pending) and all claims, (e) the Contractor's and Architect's certifications, (f) the construction inspector's report, (g) the Interest Reserve reconciliation required by **Section 8.5**, and (h) a statement of Equity Contributions applied to date.

## Section 23.2 Quarterly Financial Statements

Borrower shall deliver to Lender, within forty-five (45) days after the end of each Fiscal Quarter, unaudited financial statements of Borrower (balance sheet, income statement and statement of cash flows, with a comparison to the Approved Budget), a Rent Roll (if any leases are in place), a leasing status report, a schedule of accounts payable aged sixty (60) days or more, and a certification of compliance with the Financial Covenants.

## Section 23.3 Annual Financial Statements

Borrower shall deliver to Lender, within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of each Fiscal Year, (a) audited financial statements of Borrower prepared by a nationally or regionally recognized independent certified public accounting firm acceptable to Lender, (b) the annual net worth certification required by **Section 16.5**, and (c) the compliance certificate required by **Section 16.8**.

## Section 23.4 Guarantor Reporting

Borrower shall cause each Guarantor to deliver the financial statements, liquidity certifications and tax returns required by **Section 13.9**.

## Section 23.5 Quarterly Guarantor Liquidity Certifications

Borrower shall deliver to Lender, within forty-five (45) days after the end of each Fiscal Quarter, a certification of the combined Liquid Assets of the Guarantors, in form satisfactory to Lender, together with supporting statements from each Guarantor's financial institutions (or such other evidence as Lender may reasonably require).

## Section 23.6 Notices

Borrower shall deliver the notices required by **Section 15.1(i)** within the time periods specified therein (and in any event within five (5) Business Days after Borrower obtains knowledge of the applicable event).

## Section 23.7 Other Information; Audit Rights

Borrower shall deliver to Lender such other information, certificates, budgets, leases, contracts and reports as Lender may reasonably request, and shall permit Lender and its representatives to audit and copy Borrower's books and records relating to the Property, the Project and the Loan at any time during normal business hours upon reasonable notice.

## Section 23.8 Know Your Customer

Borrower shall deliver to Lender such information and documentation as Lender may reasonably request to comply with its customer identification, beneficial ownership and anti-money-laundering requirements, and shall promptly notify Lender of any change in the identity of its beneficial owners.

# ARTICLE 24 — EVENTS OF DEFAULT

## Section 24.1 Monetary Default

Borrower fails to pay any principal, interest, fee or other amount due under any Loan Document when due, and such failure continues for five (5) days after the due date; *provided* that no grace period shall apply to (a) the payment due on the Maturity Date, (b) any payment required under **Section 2.4**, **Section 8.3(b)**, **Section 16.3(b)** or **Section 16.4(b)**, or (c) any payment due after acceleration.

## Section 24.2 Representation Default

Any representation or warranty made by Borrower or any Guarantor in any Loan Document, or in any certificate, report, financial statement or other document furnished in connection therewith, proves to have been untrue, incorrect or misleading in any material respect when made or deemed made.

## Section 24.3 Covenant Default

Borrower or any Guarantor fails to observe or perform any covenant, condition or agreement contained in any Loan Document (other than a covenant for which a specific remedy is provided in **Article 16** or elsewhere, or a covenant described in **Sections 24.1** through **24.2** and **24.4** through **24.19**), and such failure continues for thirty (30) days after the earlier of (a) written notice from Lender and (b) the date on which Borrower obtains knowledge of such failure; *provided* that if such failure is capable of cure but cannot reasonably be cured within such thirty (30) day period, and Borrower is diligently and continuously pursuing cure, such period shall be extended for an additional thirty (30) days (but in no event beyond the Maturity Date). The extension in the preceding sentence shall not apply to any failure to maintain insurance, to any failure to deliver a required payment, to any breach of **Article 17** or **Article 18**, or to any failure to satisfy a Financial Covenant (as to which **Article 16** provides the exclusive cure).

## Section 24.4 Cross-Default

(a) A default or event of default occurs under the Mezzanine Loan, the Intercreditor Agreement or the mezzanine pledge documents, or (b) Borrower or any Guarantor defaults (beyond any applicable notice and cure period) under any other Indebtedness or material agreement involving an obligation in excess of $500,000, including the GMP Contract, the Architect's Agreement or the CC&Rs.

## Section 24.5 Bankruptcy and Insolvency

Borrower, any Guarantor, any member of Borrower, the Mezzanine Lender, Brightleaf Investors Group LLC or any Affiliate of any of the foregoing (a) commences any case, proceeding or other action under any bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, liquidation, dissolution or similar law, (b) consents to the institution of, or fails to contest in good faith within sixty (60) days, any such proceeding, (c) applies for or consents to the appointment of a receiver, trustee, custodian, conservator, liquidator or similar official, (d) makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors, (e) admits in writing its inability to pay its debts generally as they become due, or (f) suffers the entry of an order for relief or the appointment of a receiver, trustee or custodian that is not dismissed within sixty (60) days.

## Section 24.6 Judgments

One or more judgments, orders or decrees for the payment of money in an aggregate amount exceeding $500,000 (not covered by insurance as to which the insurer has acknowledged coverage in writing) is entered against Borrower, any Guarantor or the Property, and remains unsatisfied, unbonded or unstayed for thirty (30) days, or any such judgment is enforced against the Property.

## Section 24.7 Liens; Attachment

Any claim of lien, levy, attachment, execution, sequestration or other process is issued or filed against the Property, the Project or any other collateral and is not released, bonded off or stayed within thirty (30) days, or any Lien other than a Permitted Exception or a Lien in favor of Lender attaches to the Property.

## Section 24.8 Material Adverse Change

A material adverse change occurs in the financial condition, business, operations, properties or prospects of Borrower, any Guarantor, the Project or the Property, or in the value of the collateral, as determined by Lender in its reasonable discretion, including any material decline in the as-completed or as-stabilized value of the Property, any material increase in Total Project Costs not funded as required by this Agreement, or any material impairment of the enforceability of the Loan Documents.

## Section 24.9 Construction Delay Default

The Project is more than ninety (90) days behind the Baseline Schedule (as adjusted for Approved Change Orders and Unavoidable Delays) at any time during the Construction Period, or Borrower fails to achieve Substantial Completion on or before the Outside Completion Date (a "**Construction Delay Default**").

## Section 24.10 Abandonment; Suspension

Borrower or the Contractor suspends or abandons construction of the Project for more than fifteen (15) consecutive days (other than as permitted by **Section 10.1**), or Borrower fails to cause construction to commence within thirty (30) days after Closing.

## Section 24.11 Insurance

Borrower fails to maintain any insurance required by **Article 20** in full force and effect for more than ten (10) days after the earlier of notice from Lender and the date on which Borrower obtains knowledge of such failure.

## Section 24.12 SPE Covenants; Independent Manager

Borrower breaches any covenant in **Article 18**, or the Operating Agreement is amended in any manner that eliminates, weakens or renders ineffective the SPE covenants or the Independent Manager provisions.

## Section 24.13 Environmental Default

(a) Borrower fails to comply with any condition of the NFA Letter, the Soil Management Plan or the Deed Notice; (b) any violation of any Environmental Law occurs with respect to the Property that requires reporting, investigation, remediation or payment of a penalty in excess of $100,000; (c) any Governmental Authority issues any order, directive, notice of violation or administrative complaint relating to Hazardous Materials at the Property; (d) any lien arises under any Environmental Law; or (e) any Release of Hazardous Materials occurs at the Property that is not promptly remediated in accordance with Environmental Laws.

## Section 24.14 Guaranty Default; Guarantor Events

(a) Any Guarantor repudiates, revokes, terminates, disaffirms or challenges the validity or enforceability of any Guaranty, or fails to perform any obligation thereunder; (b) any Guarantor dies, becomes incapacitated, or becomes the subject of any Insolvency Event; (c) any Guarantor fails to satisfy any covenant in **Section 13.8** and does not cure within the period permitted by **Section 13.8(d)**; or (d) any Guarantor is convicted of, or pleads guilty or nolo contendere to, a felony or any crime involving fraud or dishonesty.

## Section 24.15 Failure to Complete

Final Completion has not occurred on or before the date that is one hundred eighty (180) days after the Outside Completion Date.

## Section 24.16 Interest Reserve; Equity

(a) Borrower fails to fund an Interest Reserve Shortfall within the period required by **Section 8.3(b)**; (b) Borrower fails to fund the Required Equity Contribution or any additional Equity Contribution required by **Section 2.4**; or (c) Borrower fails to satisfy the conditions to conversion to the Mini-Perm Period on or before the Construction Maturity Date.

## Section 24.17 Prohibited Transfer; Change of Control

Any sale, transfer, encumbrance or other disposition of the Property or any membership interest in Borrower occurs in violation of this Agreement, or any change of control of Borrower occurs (including by reason of the exercise of remedies by the Mezzanine Lender).

## Section 24.18 Title; Permits; CC&Rs

The Title Policy is not issued at Closing, any title defect or unpermitted encumbrance arises, any required permit, approval, certificate of occupancy or architectural review approval is revoked, suspended or expires and is not reinstated within thirty (30) days, or the Property becomes non-conforming under the CC&Rs or applicable zoning.

## Section 24.19 Notice and Cure; No Implied Waiver

Lender shall not be required to give notice of any Event of Default except to the extent expressly provided in this Article. Any notice given with respect to one Default or Event of Default shall not constitute a waiver or cure of any other Default or Event of Default. The acceptance by Lender of any payment after the occurrence of an Event of Default shall not constitute a waiver of such Event of Default or of any other Event of Default.

# ARTICLE 25 — REMEDIES

## Section 25.1 Acceleration

Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, Lender may, at its option and without further notice to Borrower (except as required by applicable law), declare the entire outstanding principal balance of the Loan, together with all accrued and unpaid interest, fees, costs, expenses and other Obligations, immediately due and payable, whereupon the same shall become immediately due and payable. Upon the occurrence of an Event of Default described in **Section 24.5**, all amounts shall become automatically due and payable without notice or demand of any kind.

## Section 25.2 Suspension of Advances

Upon the occurrence of a Default or an Event of Default, Lender may cease making any further Advances, including any Advance previously approved, and may withhold the release of any Retainage.

## Section 25.3 Default Rate

Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, all outstanding amounts shall bear interest at the Default Rate as provided in **Section 3.4**.

## Section 25.4 Foreclosure and Other Real Property Remedies

Lender may foreclose the Deed of Trust in accordance with the power of sale contained therein and applicable North Carolina law, including N.C.G.S. Chapter 45, Article 2A, or may proceed by judicial foreclosure, and may exercise any and all other rights and remedies available to a mortgagee under North Carolina law, including the right to seek the appointment of a receiver under N.C.G.S. §1-501 *et seq.*, to obtain possession of the Property, to collect rents (whether by assignment of rents, pendente lite receivership or otherwise), and to apply for a deficiency judgment in accordance with N.C.G.S. §45-21.36.

## Section 25.5 UCC Remedies

Lender may exercise all rights and remedies of a secured party under Article 9 of the UCC and other applicable law with respect to the personal property collateral and the pledged membership interests, including (a) the right to file UCC-1 and UCC-8 financing statements, (b) the right to notify account debtors and obligors to make payment directly to Lender, (c) the right to sell, assign, transfer or otherwise dispose of the membership interests at public or private sale (and Lender may be the purchaser at any such sale to the extent permitted by law), (d) the right to exercise the irrevocable proxies granted under **Section 12.2** and to vote the membership interests, and (e) the right to exercise all rights of the pledgor of the membership interests.

## Section 25.6 Guaranty Remedies
